Adan'f blood warrior.description: Like all of the Adan'f race, the bloodwarrior vaguely resembles a large lizard, complete with green-black scales and forked tongue. Slitted red eyes are set deeply into its triangular skull, over triple rows of gleaming pointed teeth. A long, sinuous neck leads down to a stocky body, thickly corded with muscle. The bloodwarrior's large chest and legs provide great strength and speed, and its long barbed tail provides excellent balance. Its arms end in three strong fingers, tipped by sharp, stained claws.

Adan'f shadow mage.description: Like all of the Adan'f race, the mage vaguely resembles a large lizard, complete with reddish-black scales and forked tongue. Slitted golden eyes are set deeply into its narrow skull, over triple rows of gleaming pointed teeth. A long, sinuous neck leads down to a slender, almost frail, body. Its delicate tail is tipped with one gleaming talon, though the tail appears too weak to use as a weapon. The mage wears a long hooded cloak of deep black cloth, its surface lumpy with concealed items. One of its three-fingered hands holds an oak staff topped with a jackal's skull.

Adan'f spirit dancer.description: Like all of the Adan'f race, the spirit dancer vaguely resembles a large lizard, complete with blue-black scales and forked tongue. Slitted silver eyes are set deeply into its triangular skull, over triple rows of gleaming pointed teeth. A long, sinuous neck leads down to a graceful body, rippled with muscle. The spirit dancer's powerful legs give it great strength and speed, and its long curved tail lends it incredible balance.

Antelope.description: The sleek antelope looks graceful and quick. It appears to be passive but may fight back if provoked.

Arbelog.description: The arbelog stands about six feet in height, humanoid in appearance, with inordinately long, muscular arms and prehensile-toed feet. It is covered with thick brown fur, lighter at the belly and face, a dark stripe running down its back. Large heavily lidded eyes peer out over a flat wrinkled nose and nearly lipless mouth.

Angiswaerd hatchling.description: Merely the length of a full grown Gor'Tog, the angiswaerd hatchling is too small to engulf its prey whole like its full grown counterparts. Instead, it would surely rely on remaining below ground and out of sight until ravenous hunger forces it to the surface in search of food. This one is currently in just such a mode, seeking a meal over safety. [You can not LOOK to see wounds or what it carries. This is not a bug.]

Alley thug.name: alley thug or street thug
Alley thug.description: The street/alley thug looks pretty typical for a , but has the symbolic crossed daggers of the Fade Gang tattooed on arm, visible just under the sleeve. Outfitted for survival, also bears the scars of one living in derelict conditions. With a smug look on face, the thug gazes about, ready to drive anyone out of territory.

Adult desert armadillo (1).description: Thick, articulated hide plating covers the desert armadillo from its dripping, twitchy snout to its barbed tail. Perfectly adapted to blend into a desert environment, the animal's coloration is a mottled patchwork of sand and tan. With powerful claws for digging protective burrows, a barbed tail, and flexible plating that allows the creature to roll itself up tightly, the armadillo appears well built to defend itself.

Albino cave fish.description: They come in many sizes and varieties, but for most people who encounter these sleek predators, it is the rows of razor-sharp teeth and souless black eyes that will forever linger in their minds.

Amalgamated fleshreaper.description: A hideous amalgam of shattered, twisted, and fused bone, the fearsome hulk before you rises to the height of several Gor'Togs. Clearly no natural beast possesses a skeletal structure as horrific as this - with uneven limbs formed of irregular, contorted lengths of flesh-stripped bone. Its claws are incongruent and jagged, bearing the unmistakable crimson stain of dried blood. Only a Necromancer of considerable power and vileness could meld the deceased bodies of so many beasts into such a horrific construct.

Arisen Rakash ranger.description: Mangy skin covers the race is::Rakash ranger, tightly stretched over bone and rotting sinew. Despite the fact that its features are badly distended and bloated, the lupine nature of its former race in moonskin is evident. A stench of decay rises from the ranger, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice.

Abominable umbral race.name: abominable umbral ''<Race>''
Abominable umbral race.description: Standing before you is the spitting image of a , or at least it would be if it were not for the fact that every inch of it is a varying and surreal shade of grey or black, even its clothing. Its motions are twitchy and erratic, due to the fact that its body seems to skip small amounts of intervening space every time it moves. The monochromatic goop that it is made of smells slightly foul, and bits of it trail or rub off on everything the creature touches. The umbral is clearly an abomination and a mockery of nature itself.

Adult razortusk sow.description: Closely resembling her smaller domesticated cousin, the razortusk sow adds beady, bloodshot eyes and razor-sharp tusks to the normal porcine physique.

Adult razortusk boar.description: Closely resembling his smaller domesticated cousin, the razortusk boar adds beady, bloodshot eyes and razor-sharp tusks to the normal porcine physique.

Alfar Avenger.description: Though her skin glistens with the purest of white, this particular alfar avenger appears much like an emaciated, clean-shaven Gnome. In one hand, she grips a sharp blade of unusual design while her immense, pitch-black eyes unblinkingly watch for threats.

Alfar Warrior.description: A sedate alfar warrior is tall and fair of face, with clear eyes and white skin that gleams like ceramic. Its features are all sharp angles, with oblique cat-slitted eyes that survey its surroundings with an untouchable serenity. Its pointed ears sweep upward, accentuating the eagle-like hauteur of its mien. Its lips are tinted blue, the color of a bruise, and are set in a grim line. Flat black clasps gather its colorless hair, binding it into a severe, warlike queue that brushes its waist. Thin and attenuated, though with a wiry strength, this warrior of the alfar is not obviously male or female.

Akul'tiz ghost.description: The Akul'tiz ghost is little more than a many-limbed stick figure of seething mist, existing in the Plane of Abiding by dint of an unyielding vengeful will.

Akul'tiz shadow matriarch.description: The Akul'tiz is a short, plump humanoid swathed in a blue robe, with hairless grey skin that hangs flaccidly from its frame. It goes barefoot, which may help account for the creature's remarkable speed and agility. Tipping its grub-like fingers are long, sharpened nails painted a bright malachite-green. Its rattish face wears a fixed smile on jaws too wide, teeth too white. This shadow matriarch has been heavily tattooed head-to-toe to the point that it appears solid black, leaving only the eyelids to betray its natural complexion.

This shadow witch has been heavily tattooed head-to-toe to the point that it appears solid black, leaving only the eyelids to betray its natural complexion. A holy aura of malevolence emanates from the shadow witch, the darkness exuding a disturbing black radiance. It is wearing a . It is carrying a . An Akul'tiz shadow witch falls to the ground. Its eyes roll up in its head, and its grin relaxes into death's universal mask, its wounds glowing with the mark of the holy.

Adult wyvern.description: One of the legendary predators that skulk the face of Elanthia, the wyvern embodies the perfect combination of raw killing strength and razor-keen intelligence. Hunched forward on two immense legs, the wyvern towers at nearly twenty feet tall, ready to lash outwards at a moment's notice. Sharp serpentine features grace its enormous triangular skull, occasionally curling its maw with a rumbling snarl to display the scimitar-sized serrated fangs, perfect for tearing flesh from bone.

Animated Items (1).description: Animated items come in many shapes and sizes. This one is a petite or small item. Where item can be one of the following: * fork * griddle * knife * lid * pan * plate * pot * spoon * teapot

Animated Items (2).description: Animated items come in many shapes and sizes. This one is a large item. Where item can be one of the following: * caldron * hoe * pitchfork * rake * sickle * shovel * whip

Animated Items (3).description: Animated items come in many shapes and sizes. This one is a gigantic item. Where item can be one of the following: * adze * auger * drill * file * level * saw * screwdriver

Animated Items (4).description: Animated items come in many shapes and sizes. This one is a colossal item. Where item can be one of the following: * broom * candlestick * doll * book * pen * scroll * shoe * stool

Andesite gargoyle.description: Composed of rock, the gargoyle is a statue come to life at the hand of an ambitious mage. Mostly irate at the world and grumbling to itself about anything from the state of the Elven nation to the weather, the gargoyle does not look so much inclined to fight as it is to curl up in a corner and look frightening. Still, it knows its task as a protector of its creator's domain, and will do its best to keep invaders from treading on its turf.

Arisen ghoulish beggar.description: Still dressed in the remnants of its former life, the arisen ghoul doesn't quite shamble about, but still moves without purpose. It is clear that whatever force created the ghoul is long gone now, though its curse of unlife remains. The ghoulish beggar is dressed in mostly rags.

Arisen ghoulish farmer.description: Still dressed in the remnants of its former life, the arisen ghoul doesn't quite shamble about, but still moves without purpose. It is clear that whatever force created the ghoul is long gone now, though its curse of unlife remains. The ghoulish farmer appears to be dressed in clothes best suited for working on a farm.

Andesite guardian.description: ==In Depth== You see a andesite guardian. The andesite guardian is in good shape. It is wearing nothing! It is carrying a , a . They may throw the boulders at you. ------------- A chance encounter ------------ It is the 10th month of Nissa the Maiden in the year of the Golden Panther. I encountered a small group of about 20 of these invading Riverhaven. I was able to handle the regular ones pretty easily, being an Experienced Aficionado (180ish) in weapons and Adept in armor, evasion, and such. Took lots of blows, though, and could only handle 1 at a time. In the end, it took several buffs and boosts to really be able to kill them efficiently. The "Regulars" were mixed with Veterans that were much tougher, and it took a long time to wear them down and finally turn them to rubble. It would be best to stay away from these guardians unless you are a solid Adept (220+) in most skills; otherwise, you likely won't make it. Most stats 35 to 39, agility and reflexes around the same, and I would say this is the bottom of the rung. They seemed immune to several lunar spells, and edged weapons didn't do much; in the end, we just ended up duking it out. - Phillum ----- End ----

Slitted golden eyes are set deeply into its narrow skull, over triple rows of gleaming pointed teeth. A long, sinuous neck leads down to a slender, almost frail, body. The mage wears a long hooded cloak of deep black cloth, its surface lumpy with concealed items. One of its three-fingered hands holds an oak staff topped with a jackal's skull. Shares its description with Adan'f shadow mage.

Adult sovamedo.description: The sovamedo is a curious creature with characteristics of both an owl and a bear. It has thick limbs that enable it to swiftly cover large distances on all fours, though when defending its territory, it is more commonly seen standing on its two hind legs to allow great, sweeping strikes from its forearms. Vicious, curved claws protrude from each massive paw, and a similarly wicked beak accentuates the golden, intensely intelligent eyes and horns of its owl-like head. Long, colorful feathers adorn the beast's upper body while golden fur grows out from beneath the plumage to cover it from its broad shoulders down.

Beisswurm.description: The beisswurm does not seem to have the fully developed body of the lesser known adult. Long, thin and with razor sharp teeth, it slithers contentedly along the ground until it discovers its next meal. Only later in life does it grow legs and develop the ability to deliver icy breath.

Armored warklin.description: The armored warklin resembles some of the more exotic tropical beetle forms, inasmuch as it has many legs, and a hardened carapace surrounding its segmented body. The two legs closest to its face are heavily armored, the plates covered with sharp, serrated edges and capped with barbed hooks. However, the remaining legs are incredibly long, and arch up perhaps a Tog in height before descending to where the body hangs several handsbreadths above the ground. Glossy black eyes peer out from behind a visor-like shell protrusion, seemingly looking into distant space, but the jerking precision of its movements suggests that it is fully aware of what transpires around it. That and the speed with which it rends apart invaders to its dwelling demonstrates its strangely insectile cunning.

Bison.description: The large bison looks powerful and skittish. It appears to be passive but may be dangerous if scared or threatened.

Blood wolf (1).description: A beautiful red coat, flecked with gray, does not totally conceal the powerful form which lies beneath the wolf's exterior. A toothy "smile" accompanied by a low growl gives fair warning to those who pass by this carnivorous beast.

Asaren celpeze (1).description: The asaren celpeze is a mottled lizard the size of a large hunting cat. Elven for "sea lizard", the asaren celpeze are generally content to bask on rocks or beaches near the ocean. Their tough hide is prized for armor, and their pointed teeth valued for many uses, from arrow points to being ground for alchemical compounds. Right now it is in full threat display: crest standing straight up, tail switching back and forth, and jewel-like eyes open wide.

Blue-belly crocodile (1).description: The blue-belly crocodile is large, approximately 30 feet in length from snout to tail. Bony plates cover its back and tail forming a kind of armor on its thick skin. The crocodile has a long, triangular snout. Its teeth, 30 to 40 in each jaw, are set into sockets in the jawbones and interlock when the mouth is closed; the fourth tooth from the front on each side of the jaw can always be seen, even when its mouth is shut. It is amphibious, spending most of time in the water, where it swims with rhythmic strokes of its tail. The tail is also used to capture prey, sweeping it from shallow to deeper water, where it can be devoured more easily. As it floats almost completely submerged, the crocodile's protruding nostrils and eyes and a portion of its back are the only parts visible as it stalks its prey. It moves most quickly in a belly crawl, but can also walk on all four legs.

Black marble gargoyle.description: Crafted from lustrous black marble, the gargoyle is a statue granted life to serve as a guardian of its creator's domain. With a head and body of a lion, stunted draconic wings and a serpentine tail, the gargoyle is curiously elegant despite its incongruous parts. Sculpted muscles move with predatory grace, while razor-sharp claws and curving incisors promise lethal violence. A broad collar of intertwined adders is chiseled around its neck.

Black ape.description: Standing at seven feet in height, the ape seems to be composed entirely of muscle. The ape's black fur is weathered with its eyes vigilant for intruders of its domain. There is silver fur running across the ape's chest.

Blood dryad.description: The blood dryad's skin is dark brownish-black, and patterned like bark. A mane of hair composed of blighted and decaying leaves cascades down her back and shoulders and her glowing saffron eyes glare hatefully at you, as if accusing you of wrongs done to her kind in the past. Her hands end in massive claws that resemble branches, and a sticky, reddish substance covers her skin, glistening slightly.

Blood nyad.description: Looking more like a sculpture of ruddy water than anything human, the blood nyad may have been beautiful once, but that beauty has long since faded, leaving a twisted, terribly disfigured creature that stares at you with blazing red eyes.

Black bear.description: The black bear's hypnotic effect of swinging its head from side to side is dispelled when you realize that you have encountered a foe with sharp claws, powerful jaws, and quick reflexes.

Bawdy swain.description: The bawdy swain is a belligerent and slightly drunk !

Black goblin.description: The black race is::goblin stares back at you with pale green eyes. Taller than an average Human and with a broad barrel chest, the black goblin supports its muscular frame on slightly bowed legs. Its thick ebon skin is heavily creased and resembles charred wood, an adaptation this breed has developed to blend easily into the shadows. The black goblin wears crudely stitched patchwork hunting leathers and a lopsided smirk. A woven harness filled fitted with numerous dull iron hurling axes is slung haphazardly over its shoulder, rattling softly against each other with every narrow stride.

Armored shalswar.MapList: *{{rmap|126 | Outside Raven's Point Map (126)}}*{{rmap|141 | Crystalline Gorge, Western Road (141)}}
Armored shalswar.description: Perched upon two muscular hind legs, the an armored shalswar bears a strong resemblance to an earlier species of Adan'f. Its stocky, scaled body is adorned with intricately carved plates of armor, partially obscured by the bright purple and crimson banners draped over its flank. A heavily scratched steel bit clenched between its three rows of saw-like teeth lead to a set of thick leather reins tightly grasped by a heavily-armored Dragon Priest perched upon a saddle secured to its back. Two dangerous-looking claws, each bearing three severely curved talons perfectly equipped for ripping flesh, dangle before its body within the long shadow cast by its elongated neck.

Asketian harbinger.name: Asketian harbinger
Asketian harbinger.description: Gaunt skin covers the Asketian harbinger, tightly stretched over bone and rotting sinew. It is obviously humanoid, but so badly distended and bloated are its features that precisely what race is a mystery. A stench of decay rises from the harbinger, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice.

Asketian herald.name: Asketian herald
Asketian herald.description: Gaunt skin covers the Asketian herald, tightly stretched over bone and rotting sinew. It is obviously humanoid, but so badly distended and bloated are its features that precisely what race is a mystery. A stench of decay rises from the herald, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice.

Baby forest gryphon.description: Smaller than a standard gryphon, the forest gryphon has the body of a bobcat with its fluffy bobbed tail and plush tawny fur, while soft brown and white feathers cover the forequarters and wings. The creature's cat-slitted orange eyes are flecked with crimson veins around the pupil. Though not yet strong enough to fly, the gryphon's wings are well able to deliver a good buffet to the unwary, while its beak can dismember a small deer for dinner.

Blood-thirsty lascar.description: ==In Depth== It is wearing some . It is carrying a , a .

Ashu hhinvi.description: Towering into the air at least twenty feet, the monstrosity exists in a constant state of reconfiguration as it draws the blistering desert sands into its ever-changing body. Rudimentary, fingerless hands culminate the long, broad arms -- perfect for pummeling the air and blasting anything in the way. The creature's legs stretch directly into the ground, holding the torso aloft like stilts without any discernable feet. No proper face is evident save for a few depressions in the sand for eyes, mouth and nose, giving the being an uncaring, unyielding, unrelenting expression.

Arthelun cabalist.description: Literal flames dance in place of his eyes and curls of smoke seep from the Rakash's fissured flesh. He moves with a sinuous grace and seems utterly at ease with the raging inferno that shrouds him. (can be a variety of races) You see an arthelun cabalist. The arthelun cabalist is in good shape. It is wearing a . It is carrying a , a .

Banshee.description: The banshee is a spectral being, female in form. Her hands form sharp claws capable of rending all matter, her own insubstantial being torn and wounded by her desperate self-mutilation. She moans and cries, her hair a dissheveled mop, her garments tattered to pathetic rags.

Beltunumshi (1).description: A central bark-covered stump is surrounded by whirling vines. Old scorch marks mar the scaley bark and malevolent eyes shine forth above a gaping maw that must be the mouth.

Blood wolf (2).description: A beautiful red coat, flecked with gray, does not totally conceal the powerful form which lies beneath the wolf's exterior. A toothy "smile" accompanied by a low growl gives fair warning to those who pass by this carnivorous beast.

Blue-dappled prereni (1).description: A rather small species of deer, the prereni is unusual in that it will aggressively defend its territory. Standing about ten and a half hands high, it is characterized by its delicately pointed ears and a grey coat patterned with blued spots.

Blight locust.description: Alive: Grown long and dark brown with muscular shoulders to power membranous wings, the blight locust is about the size of a large dog and looks ready to devour most anything in its path. A light pollen-like dusting covers its chitinous back and enormous legs, and its mandibles drip with an unhealthy looking venom. Dead: A nightmarish blight locust is nothing more than a slowly leaking husk. It's pretty disgusting.

Arisen ghoulish fisher.description: Still dressed in the remnants of its former life, the arisen ghoul doesn't quite shamble about, but still moves without purpose. It is clear that whatever force created the ghoul is long gone now, though its curse of unlife remains. The ghoulish fisher is still wielding a skinning knife and is dressed up for fishing.

Arisen ghoulish teacher.description: Still dressed in the remnants of its former life, the arisen ghoul doesn't quite shamble about, but still moves without purpose. It is clear that whatever force created the ghoul is long gone now, though its curse of unlife remains. The ghoulish teacher is dressed in an outfit resembling a schoolteacher's clothes.

Arisen ghoulish socialite.description: Still dressed in the remnants of its former life, the arisen ghoul doesn't quite shamble about, but still moves without purpose. It is clear that whatever force created the ghoul is long gone now, though its curse of unlife remains. The ghoulish socialite is dressed in what used to be rather nice clothing.

Black Fang watcher.description: Former scouts, scryers, and spies of the Melyo Rensh'a, Black Fang watchers generally eschew combat in favor of stealthy observation, but they are far from harmless if provoked to fight. A dour demeanor indicates this one is no exception.

Black Fang recruit.description: Although they lack the rigorous training that former agents of the All-Seeing Eye possess, decades of desperate Undershard living have hardened the crop of Black Fang recruits into vicious warriors not to be underestimated. This one in particular seems to have aggression to spare.

Black Fang deadeye.description: Elusive and deadly, Black Fang deadeyes represent an elite class of ranged assassin culled from the former ranks of the Melyo Rensh'a. Scant few have been known to escape their quarry alive, and this one seems like an especially battle-hardened specimen.

Augmented arachnid.description: The description will change based on the type and augmentation of the arachnid type. A few examples include: :* The nightstalker unyn is an arachnid larger than a Gor'Tog, without adding in the legs. Wiry black hairs cover its entire body, except for three crimson stripes running down its back. Thick fangs protrude from its mouth, seemingly blacker than its body, if that's possible. The nightstalker variety is somewhat plumper and more violent than its nightweaving and nightreaving relatives. It is highly aggressive, and always hungry. :: This particular nightstalker unyn appears to have been surgically augmented with bronze. :* The blade spider is covered with thick chitinous plates, appearing not unlike a suit of armor with numerous legs. Sword-shaped blades run along the back of the spider's front appendages and multi-faceted eyes peer quizzically from over a set of vice-like barbed mandibles. :: This particular blade spider appears to have been surgically augmented with silver.

Birdcatcher spider.description: Lighter brown underneath, the upper parts of the birdcatcher spider is a dark russet brown. Bristly hairs erupt from the multi-jointed legs. Two sets of eyes stare out over the sharp fangs, which are poised to strike.

Dark enough to disappear into shadows and patient enough to wait for the perfect opportunity to pounce, it watches and waits for the weaknesses of its prey. Golden-green eyes glitter in the blackness of its form, but once you have noticed those eyes, most assuredly you are already considered a snack.

Beltunumshi (2).description: A central bark-covered stump is surrounded by whirling vines. Old scorch marks mar the scaley bark and malevolent eyes shine forth above a gaping maw that must be the mouth.

Cougar.description: The cougar has a powerful body that is all sinewy muscle, a perfect hunting and killing machine. Its short tan coat looks rough and dull from years in the wilds. Dark luminous eyes stare at you hypnotically.

Clouded arzumos.description: Lithe and elegant, every line of this great cat is predatory. Its sapphire-blue eyes with slitted black pupils are alert and intelligent, never missing even the slightest movement. Razor-sharp claws are neatly sheathed within its big paws, and its oversized incisors arc to just below the lower jaw, giving it lethal piercing and crushing power. Supple muscles move fluidly under creamy, faintly-striped fur with tawny tips, lending the cat the look of being dusted with gold.

Bobcat.description: The bobcat is poised, graceful, and appears to be at ease yet ready to spring. It fixes its golden eyes on you, and you are mesmerized for a moment, yet your instincts scream to submit as you look away first. Finally the bobcat turns his attention elsewhere, looking bored by the encounter. Yet you are certain it will mark your every move with a wariness it does not show.

Brown burrower.description: The burrower is a large insectile shape, perhaps as big as a small Halfling. It runs about rapidly on many jointed legs. Colored a muck brown, the brown burrower carapace glistens with a repulsive sheen. A large head, in which a quartet of enormous, multi-facted eyes refract all light into coldly glinting shards, is armed with a brace of wickedly serrated mandibles. A tiny mouth ringed with dozens of wriggling palps like boneless fingers serves to manipulate the grotesque fragments of flesh that it dines upon. The two front legs have been turned into fighting weapons, edged with hooks and jagged serrations curling back towards the waiting mandibles. Above all rises a horrid stink of indescribable rot and foulness, a reek that reminds you of an opened cesspit or a charnel house.

Corpse grub.description: The grub is not so much a grub as a bloated sack of formless jelly. It extrudes long pseudopods across the ground to move, dragging itself along or rising up to climb. The color of wet liver, the hide looks slimy and almost greasy. Perhaps the size of a halfling, it has no visible sense organs or extremities.

Cave bear.description: The cave bear's hypnotic effect of swinging its head from side to side is dispelled when you realize that you have encountered a foe with sharp claws, powerful jaws, and quick reflexes.

Bone wolf.description: Small, thin, and ill-tempered as displayed by a warning growl, the beast is an ugly cousin of the other wolves of Elanthia. Its thick hide offers great protection but is an unsightly dull gray marked by intermittent splotches of coarse fur.

Bristle-backed peccary.description: At first glance, you think boar but when you see the peccary in full you realize this is a different animal entirely. However like the common boar the tiny eyes and massive snout are caged behind two mean-looking curved tusks. Its startlingly white lips contrast sharply with its dark grey almost black hide.

Caracal.description: The caracal looks like a small, muscular cougar with ridiculously long legs and a short, stubby tail. A tuft of fine hair sticks up from the top of each ear, and you'd almost laugh at it - if the creature weren't three feet long with impressive teeth, claws, and speed.

Blueclaw sand crab.description: The sand crab is unusual and not quite like anything you have ever set eyes on. You're not sure just what to make of it.

Botuk hei.description: Vaguely human-like, the botuk hei's ears seem to have grown to the size of spread hands at the expense of its eyes, which are almost buried under thick white fur. Its cheeks have retracted, leaving its mandibles projecting under a wide-nostrilled nose. Its limbs are grotesquely long and twisted, each arm ending in a hand tipped with five long claws.

Blue-green pivuh.description: Standing on four stout legs, this lizard-like creature is about the size of a farmer's prize pig. Glittering blue-green scales glisten as they shift and move over its heavily muscled frame, giving way to brightly feathered wings which sprout from its back. Beady black eyes peer malevolently about, predatory and dangerous.

Corsair.description: The corsair is dressed much like any sailor would be after many long days at sea. He appears happy to be on shore leave. The red/blue/green/black/yellow sash he is wearing is an indicator of which ocean sailing clan the corsair belongs to. Red Sash: talan corsair Blue Sash: tasia corsair Green Sash: telgi corsair Black Sash: hara corsair Yellow Sash: belia corsair According to The Gamgweth Dictionary talan means red, tasia means blue, telgi means green, hara means black, and belia means yellow.

Boobrie.description: Boobries are huge flightless heron-like birds, half again as tall as a human. Not content to eat worms and bugs, they prefer stabbing their victims with their vicious beaks. Through them, they suck out the juices, leaving a dried-out husk for the few desperate scavengers that will even approach such a sorry sight. One imagines it to be a very slow and painful death. Even a sluagh thinks twice about messing with a boobrie.

Cave troll.description: Cruel intelligence gleams in pale yellow eyes set beneath massive brows. Among the largest of its kin, the cave trolls towers above most creatures, massive muscles ripple beneath its grey stone-like skin, adding to its aura of intimidation

Brown bear.description: The brown bear's hypnotic effect of swinging its head from side to side is dispelled when you realize that you have encountered a foe with sharp claws, powerful jaws, and quick reflexes.

Bony fylgja.description: The bony fylgja is barely more than a skeleton, and it appears as a pale sharp-featured man, with a grin on its skin-and-bone face, and a ready axe slung above its shoulder.

Bone mammoth.description: The bone mammoth is a massive creature, covered in thick, coarse fur. Often used in war campaigns and seiges, the less violent ones are also used to transport supplies, since they tend to be fairly safe from the average brigand. Its two large tusks are dirty and scored, but speak of strength and deadliness.

Cracked bone warrior.description: Standing on two legs, the bone warrior is humanoid size. It is obviously aggressive and looking for a fight.

Brittle skeletal peon.description: Standing on two legs, the skeletal peon is humanoid size. It is obviously aggressive and looking for a fight.

Bull shark.description: They come in many sizes and varieties, but for most people who encounter these sleek predators, it is the rows of razor-sharp teeth and souless black eyes that will forever linger in their minds.

Bone amalgam.description: It is virtually impossible to describe this skeletal creature. It appears to be an amalgamation of bones from a wide variety of creatures, all fused together and animated by some form of magic. While most of the bones are natural, a few have been carved or modified to fit better, or to be more effective as weapons.

Cadaverous yeehar.description: An immense mass of shambling bones bound by slimy, blackened flesh, this behemoth is no less intimidating in undeath as it was in life. Largely visible now under the oozing skin, heavy bone plates on its head and back protect the majority of its body, and its exposed rib cage is reminiscent of a walking prison cell.

Cloud rat.description: The cloud rat is a lithe, agile creature with ash-grey fur and a thin tail. Glittering black eyes gleam through the light mist that surrounds a slate-grey cloud rat.

Clockwork assistant.description: Roughly resembling a short gnome, the clockwork assistant is made entirely of metal with exposed gears and other mechanisms allowing it to move.

Bony wind wretch.description: Draped in priestly vestments, this ancient-looking Human man cuts a frail and emaciated figure. He has mismatched eyes peering out from under his cowl, one cyan and one ebon. On his belt is a glowing silver chain threaded with a multitude of crystal beads that clatter together at every movement.

Butcherbird.description: The grey-black butcherbird is large and plump, with disheveled plumage and a vicious beak bloody from a recent kill. It constantly turns its head to and fro, as though trying to see all directions at once. Its behavior is openly belligerent toward anything that moves.

Bone wyvern.description: Hunched forward on two immense legs, the ancient bone wyvern towers at a height of over twenty feet, rotting foreclaws drawn and ready to lash outwards at a moment's notice. Its massive dragon-like skull is partially visable beneath a cloak of rotting flesh that precariously clings to its enormous skeletal body, covered in an array of jagged cracks and scratches. Twin tongues of deep purple flame rest in the hollows of its eye sockets, churning in a tempest of unfocused hatred. Gigantic skeletal wings arc outward from its spine-lined back to shadow its rotting form, and both wings are partially draped in a shifting cloak of rotting flesh.

Cloud eel.description: As long as an average Gnome's height and as thick as one's neck, the cloud eel moves about with an exceptional natural fluidity. It has benign, jewel-like silvery eyes that almost belie its predatory posture. The sleek body is covered in nacreous scales, patterned with pale cream-hued spots along its sides. The cloud eel is airborne, floating overhead effortlessly.

Brine shark.description: Looking exactly like a shark comprised of dark, brackish water, this strange construct seems to float effortlessly through the air, darting to and fro with thrusts of its angular tail. Vicious ivory teeth line its maw, and soulless cobalt eyes constantly scan the area for prey.

Copperhead viper.description: Nearly as wide as a full-grown Human, the copperhead viper is also much longer and often measures fifteen feet in length. Fierce, deadly and the foe of all who meet it, it seems at times to express almost sentient qualities. Some legends suggest that the viper was indeed among the races of our kind but was enchanted into the poisonous, hateful thing you now see.

Cinnamon bear.description: Huge, dagger like claws and an angry muzzle covered in the caked blood are frightening, but do little to detract from the cinnamon bear's magnificent golden-brown coat, highly prized by tanners.

Clockwork monstrosity.description: A dizzying tangle of brass bolts, cogs, gears, and other strange mechanisms, the clockwork monstrosity stands at about the height of a Dwarf. It has a strange metal head capped with an oilcan with large glass eyes and an ever-open mouth. Oddly thin limbs hang off its body, each one topped with a different tool, ranging from drills, pincers, mace-like spheres, and other odd attachments. The contraption appears to be keeping out a constant steady eye for intruders.

Corrupted khor'vela beltunumshi.description: A central bark-covered stump is surrounded by whirling vines. Old scorch marks mar the scaley bark and malevolent eyes shine forth above a gaping maw that must be the mouth.

Bronze leucro.description: Imposingly large in size, the bronze leucro still shares the wolfish qualities of its smaller relative, the giant black leucro. It has fur that ranges from light brown to dark grey, but always tipped in striking bronze. Often traveling in packs, the bronze leucro can overwhelm the unprepared solitary traveler.

Brown tree snake.description: Introduced in Tuesday Tidings 66. Premium Only

Breccia guardian.description: ==In Depth== You see a breccia guardian. The breccia guardian is in good shape. It is wearing nothing! It is carrying a , a . They may throw the boulders at you. ------------- A chance encounter ------------ It is the 10th month of Nissa the Maiden in the year of the Golden Panther. I encountered a small group of about 20 of these invading Riverhaven. I was able to handle the regular ones pretty easily, being an Experienced Aficionado (180ish) in weapons and Adept in armor, evasion, and such. Took lots of blows, though, and could only handle 1 at a time. In the end, it took several buffs and boosts to really be able to kill them efficiently. The "Regulars" were mixed with Veterans that were much tougher, and it took a long time to wear them down and finally turn them to rubble. It would be best to stay away from these guardians unless you are a solid Adept (220+) in most skills; otherwise, you likely won't make it. Most stats 35 to 39, agility and reflexes around the same, and I would say this is the bottom of the rung. They seemed immune to several lunar spells, and edged weapons didn't do much; in the end, we just ended up duking it out. - Phillum ----- End ----

Cadaverous blue-belly crocodile.description: The blue-belly crocodile is large, approximately 30 feet in length from snout to tail. Some of the bony plates that once served as armor for the beast are now missing while others are heavily scarred from past battles. Sightless, still eyes and far too many jagged teeth continue to convey deadly menace to anything in the crocodile's path.

Clay slayer (creature).description: ==Recall== Mass-crafted from a set of molds, the clay slayer has been expertly cast, fired, assembled, and imbued with purpose. Unlike its more simple brethren, the clay slayer is capable of advanced planning and task execution, methodically working either alone or as a group to ensure the completion of its task. Many have foolishly underestimated the constructions' capabilities. Though its creation has been long lost to history, the armor design and embellishments bear similarities to certain elements of the Empire of the Seven Pointed Star. Furthermore, the outmoded invocation of the Anther's Call spell is reminiscent of those early mages' forays into the old pattern. The result of the spell is identical to the modern version, and the clay slayer is certainly capable of taking advantage of the effect on its opponents. They are known to cast casts spell::Anther's Call. They are known to carry loot in locked boxes.

Cinderwing harpy.description: ==Recall== Harpies are often drawn to regions of strong elemental energy, adapting traits that mirror their environment. The cinderwing harpies of Pivilho Volcano have embraced both wind and fire, building their colony along the rugged volcanic slopes. Though small in stature, these harpies exhibit remarkable cunning and magical prowess -- enough to hold their own against the fiercely territorial drakes inhabiting the neighboring slope. Sightings by locals produce reports of the feathered folk stealing meat from the drakes or plummeting from the sky to snatch fish from the sea and whisking their prize back to the Ember Aerie, as their home is known to those brave enough to venture near. Many harpies possess mercurial tempers or a magpie-like tendency to steal small, shiny objects that catch their eye. They have been observed divebombing unsuspecting prey then shrieking with laughter as they fly away, leaving their victims startled but unharmed. Though it is often used with awkward syntax and harsh tones, harpies are known to speak Common when the mood strikes. The cinderwing harpys are known to cast the casts spell::Fire Shards, casts spell::Flame Shockwave, casts spell::Vertigo, and casts spell::Thunderclap spells. They are known to carry loot in locked boxes.

Bogfen golem.description: The bulky frame of the bogfen golem is sculpted from packed mud and clay, its block-like limbs crudely formed yet solid. Bald and unremarkable save for cloudy stone eyes, its heavy head rests on a thick neckless torso. Fingers and toes end in mica-streaked nails that catch faint glimmers when light strikes, despite heavy grime. Moss clings in patches across its hardened surface, and cracks in its hide reveal darker soil beneath.

Cavern bear.description: The cavern bear's hypnotic effect of swinging its head from side to side is dispelled when you realize that you have encountered a foe with sharp claws, powerful jaws, and quick reflexes.

Cutthroat (1).description: Like so many people who moved to Shard in the hopes of acquiring a new dream and a new life, the cutthroat is one of many who failed, having little choice but to take up the life of common scum just to get by in the world. From the way he eyes your money pouch, however, you're not sure exactly how much pity you can dish out to this person. After all, the cutthroat did make the decision to live his life this way...right?

Crazed madman.description: Standing on two legs the crazed madman is humanoid size and shape. Its eyes blaze with a burning hatred, unfocused but entirely malevolent.

Dark fiend.description: A truly massive figure, the fiend is draped in shadows. It's very armor appears to be fashioned from the darkness. No details of its appearance can be seen except the malevolent glow of two glaring red eyes staring out from behind its helm. They seem to look deep into your soul seeking out any deed or misvirtue for which it may be due.

Dark spirit (1).description: The dark spirit is a mass of swirling shadow given substance. Clothed in little but the rag of a robe, its hands are terribly jagged claws, its eyes a glowing sanguine color. The creature appears to have the mentality of the damned, moving with intention and deadly grace as it floats about.

Crag.description: The birch crag appears to be a large withered tree, twisted into the vague tortured shape of a man. Two large foot-like roots hold it upright, while several massive networks of branches form its arms, ending in formidable claws. It glowers at you, sweeping its wooden claws through the air menacingly. This being would tower a few feet above even the tallest Gor Tog.

Croff pothanit.description: The croff pothanit is a husky, four-footed animal with short legs and sharp front claws. It's covered with long quills which make it hard to judge anything past its general shape, but it appears to be particularly strong about the neck and shoulders. A pair of long, straight tusks protrude from its lower jaw, shiny white and flattened at the ends, which are very sharp and remind you of chisels.

Crypt fiend.description: A man-sized figure, the fiend is cloaked in swirling dense shadows which form a protective armor. No details of its appearance can be discerned except the glow of two lurid green eyes which lend a supernatural malevolence to the creature. The eyes search hungrily for the life forces that torment it so. A crypt fiend wavers when you look at it.

Damaska boar.description: A Black Goblin sits atop a damaska boar, mounted in a crudely stitched saddle and holding reins threaded through holes in the boar's enormous yellow tusks.

Cross-eyed libger.description: With a coarse fur coat of ratty brown, the crosseyed libger isn't attractive enough to bring decent value for its pelts. Its stumpy legs end in long, wickedly curved claws, and its short arms clasp a stout stick which it wields like a two-handed club. It moves with unnatural speed.

Deer.description: The sleek deer looks graceful and quick. It appears to be passive but may fight back if provoked.

Cyan mist.description: This transparent creature has no real form, though it usually maintains the appearance of a cloak. It floats effortlessly, passing through solid as if it were not there.

Dark sprite (1).description: The dark sprite is dressed in a black gossamer dress that is frayed and tattered along the bottom edges. Her eyes are as dark as coal and appear to be looking straight through to your soul. Her dark hair is shoulder length and gnarled. You almost catch a glimpse of a row of razor-sharp teeth, but when you turn to look directly at her, you see nothing but her maniacal, close-mouthed smirk that seems to taunt you and chill you at the same time.

Dergatian behemoth.description: Rivaling a mammoth in size, the Dergatian behemoth resembles a hairless star-nosed mole which has crawled out of some deranged nightmare. Its disturbingly translucent skin, while offering glimpses to the workings of the massive internal organs, appears more than thick and resilient enough to protect the beast. Dirt-caked claws as long as javelins scratch restlessly at the ground, carving up great grooves wherever it goes.

Dinanla slug.description: Exhibiting sinuous motifs of blacks and dark blues, the dinanla slug looks like an embodiment of the colors of the night. It moves remarkably fast, leaving in its wake a glimmering trail of silver slime.

Diminutive dinnsehencha.description: Blue-tinged milky eyes gaze hatefully back at you from deep within their sockets and the dark steed breathes laboriously through a gape-mouth dripping with spittle. Its thin skin stretches over a prominent ribcage beneath a dirt-encrusted saddle blanket bearing the crest of the Ferdahl's cavalry.

After all, the cutthroat did make the decision to live his life this way...right?

Deeplight fish.description: Inky black and nearly invisible in the water, the deeplight fish drifts with minimal movement, ghostly fins gently swaying in unseen still waters. A pair of pale nodules mark a bright purple streak under its large eyes, strange swirls of softly glowing light stirring within. The fish's mouth extends nearly a quarter the length of its body, filled with rows of luminous needle-like teeth.

Decomposing Merelew.description: According to folklore, Drowned Ones are the fate that awaits those who curse the gods with their last breath after falling victim to Drogor's temper. Unholy forces lurking in the ocean snatch the god-forsaken corpses and puppeteer them to some wicked end. This bloated corpse in particular features rust-mottled, metallic skin oozing pollution from every pore.

Dirt construct.description: , this creature moves quickly but with striking deliberation. Every motion has a direct purpose, and while at rest it stands unnaturally still. Its reddish-grey skin appears to be made of some porous stone, but the color shifts subtly, as though some manner of vermillion liquid roils just below the surface. Expressionless as this creature is, violence is clear in its every action.

Dinnsehencha.description: A first glance, a flaming dinnsehencha appears to be an ordinary horse, but a second look reveals flickering flames in place of the mane and tail. A brilliant red coat compliments the ruby-red hooves. Three Varieties * Burning * Flaming * Blazing * Judging from initial reaction, I do not believe these are much above 750 in natural attacking, but their magic abilities seem to exceed that abit. -- Dullen * Entrance is the arch east of the door to firecats in upper Hib. The passageway goes to the premium ara. (note will remove when maps are updated) * Seem to be glitchy in the fact that they can not attack, or cast magic while laying down (Barbarian Earth Quake in this case). * Good Perception, unable to hide even at missle at 750 ranks of Stealth buffed to around 900. * Boxes appraise at 6/17 at 880. Survival primary. * Boxes appraise at 5-8/17 at 910 Survival secondary.

Crauyarin scuttler.description: With a central body composed of conjoined geometric shapes and layered angular plating of milky red crystal, the scuttler quickly races along on its multitude of segmented, pointed limbs. Its every movement sounds faintly of shattering glass, and it appears comfortable moving in either forward or backward directions, each end terminating in the same cluster of darker material and spear-like protrusion. Internal energies pulse along the creature's body and limbs, and it moves with deadly grace.

Decaying blightwater nyad.description: You see a decaying blightwater nyad. The blightwater nyad is in good shape. It is wearing a tattered shroud woven from rotting reeds and vines, a tattered shroud woven from rotting reeds and vines. It is carrying a rotting driftwood staff, a rotting driftwood staff. ---- Atmosphere: "A decaying blightwater nyad's murky grey skin ripples like the surface of a horridly polluted lake." Death: "The eerie glow in her eyes flares before flickering out as the blightwater nyad collapses on the ground." Decay: "With a disquieting shudder, a decaying blightwater nyad's body suddenly dissolves into a puddle of stagnant water and slimy twigs."

Dengizen drake.description: Small but thick scaled plates cover the drake from head to claws while thicker, angular plates descend along the creature's back. Her tail swishes from side to side, leaving flickering sparks of electricity in its wake. With a mouth full of razor-sharp teeth and quill-like barbs protruding menacingly from the tip of her tail, the drake is built for survival -- either by overpowering her foes or enduring and outlasting their attacks.

Dusk ogre.description: Slightly smaller than a troll, this dusk ogre looks like it has been covered in a skin of hardened lava. Its face is a twisted mask of hatred, its eyes large and glowing red as hot coals. Its hands flex open, flex closed slowly, continuously, as though fed by the memory of some fond dismemberment.

Dragon Priest fanatic.description: The Priest fanatic is unusual and not quite like anything you have ever set eyes on. You're not sure just what to make of it.

Eidolon steed.description: Blue-tinged milky eyes gaze hatefully back at you from deep within their sockets and the dark steed breathes laboriously through a gape-mouth dripping with spittle. Its thin skin stretches over a prominent ribcage beneath a dirt-encrusted saddle blanket bearing the crest of the Ferdahl's cavalry.

Dusky scythewing moth.description: Upon closer observation, one immediately notices the sharp glint of silver in the scythewing moth's wings. Each wing has evolved to include a razor sharp blade-like edge that hooks downward into a vicious spike. The otherwise delicate-looking creature's body is a dusky midnight blue color, speckled symmetrically with dark purple.

Dobek moruryn.description: The dobek moruryn is a relative to the classic scorpion that has grown to a phenomenal size. Rivaling a ram in mass, the moruryn has been known to kill and eat almost anything it could sink its pincers into. Legend suggests Urrem'tier created them to protect the caverns from any intruders and to prevent them from making it back to the outerworld.

Dragon Priest assassin.description: Inky black scales cover the Dragon Priest assassin's lithe body from head to foot, undulating gently with each liberal breath slowly exhaled. A deep crimson scarf winds like a serpent around the lower features of the face, its tattered ends cascading down the wearer's back in veritable waterfall of blood-hued silk. An impressive selection of curious tools of its trade dangle from thick loops on its scuffed black leather belt, crafted for both stealthy and easy access at a moments notice. Its large glaring eyes, two pools of shadow enveloping a fiery orange halo of pigmentation, fail to reveal any hint of emotion underneath its burning gaze.

Dragon Priest juggernaut.description: Appearing like more of an ornate statue than a fearsome Dragon Priest warrior, the massive suit of intricately crafted armor, three sizes two big, dwarfs the giggling S'Kra Mur beneath. With each movement, the interlocking plates of its armor clank and squeal as they grind against one another, making it nearly impossible for the juggernaut to manage to approach its victim unnoticed. Rusty steaks of dried blood and other unidentifiable bits and pieces cling to the front of the Dragon Priest juggernaut's armor, giving nothing more then a vague suggestion of the true amount of raw killing power it possesses. An expansive array of various types of explosives dangle from a complex harness wrapped around its massive form, gently swaying to and fro with the slightest movement.

Dragon Priest crone.description: Long past the prime of her life, the Dragon Priest crone lives out her remaining years guiding the young with the ancient tales of destruction, sacrifice, and murder in the name of the World Dragon. Molted and faded scales, long having lost their youthful sheen, covers her stooped frame in random patches. Bluish-grey cataracts film her eyes, rendering the old crone almost blind. Her withered mouth is missing many incisors. The flaccid lips sag inwards causing her speech to sound even more sibilant and a little garbled.

Dragon Priest zealot.description: Like most of the lost souls who have found solace within the teachings of the World Dragon Priests, the Dragon Priest zealot has chosen to tread upon the same blood-soaked path as its fanatical predecessors. Overlapping plates of blackened steel armor protect the scaly surface of its muscular S'Kra Mur body, giving it the look of a newly discovered species of bipedal beetle. An intricately carved triangular dagger affixed to a steel chain dangles from a hook at its hip, ready to be drawn at the ready in a moments notice. Shadowed beneath the hammered visor of its dragon-shaped helm, its cold serpentine eyes constantly scan the surroundings in search of its next sacrifice in the name of the World Dragon.

Elder desert armadillo (1).description: Thick, articulated hide plating covers the desert armadillo from its dripping, twitchy snout to its barbed tail. Perfectly adapted to blend into a desert environment, the animal's coloration is a mottled patchwork of sand and tan. With powerful claws for digging protective burrows, a barbed tail, and flexible plating that allows the creature to roll itself up tightly, the armadillo appears well built to defend itself.

Elba Darvager.description: The elba Darvager is a queer creature, a product of some ill union between insect and dwarf. It looks like an over-muscled dwarf except for an extra set of long black "legs" that dangle from its midsection and a smooth, charcoal colored shell that shields its flesh body. A great horn grows out from the top of the shell, perhaps to scare off other beasts. Despite the elba Darvager's grotesque appeareance there is obvious intelligence behind dark Dwarven eyes. You notice that the elba Darvager is unnaturally quick.

Dragon Priest purifier.description: ===As Purifier=== The finer features of the Dragon Priest purifier are obscured behind the mantle of white-hot flames that engulfs its body from head to tail. A scorched srhhtel hammer, blackened steel scimitar, and jagged-edged broadsword slowly twirl end over end around its body, held aloft by some unseen force. Two inky black eyes gaze outward from within their fiery prison, eternally searching for lost souls that require purification.

Dragon Priest imperial warden.description: Rising to esteem and glory within the fanatical ranks of the World Dragon Priests, the imperial warden has beaten the odds to ascend from the lowly rank of zealot to kneel at the foot of the Blood Throne itself. The imperial warden exists only to safeguard the most esteemed amongst its bloodthirsty brethren, and is rarely seen outside of the sacred halls atop Wyvern Mountain. Standing at least as tall as a Gor'Tog, the height of the imperial warden appears odd and gangly for its frame, obviously having endured the relentless experimentation of the Dragon Priests. Thick scars bound with rusted metal staples weave across its muscular S'Kra Mur form, slipping beneath the layers of jagged ceremonial armor that covers its body.

Elder red brocket deer.description: A rather small species of deer, the brocket deer is unusual in that it will aggressively defend its territory. Standing about twelve hands high, it is characterized by its oversized ears and a reddish tint to its coat. Its front hooves are quite large in particular, ideal for use in both attacking and swift leaps.

Elpalzi mage.description: Standing near 10 feet tall, this Elpalzi rivals a Gor'Tog in both height and brawn, but far exceeds one in intellect. Rippling muscles cover its body, while its darting crystal green eyes gleam with intelligence. This creature appears mostly humanoid, if one can somehow ignore the camouflaged fur that covers its body.

Dung Beetle.description: The beetle is a large insectile shape. Perhaps as big as a small Halfling. It runs about rapidly on many jointed legs. Colored a muck brown, its carapace glistens with a repulsive sheen. A large head, in which a quartet of enormous, multi-facted eyes refract all light into coldly glinting shards, is armed with a brace of wickedly serrated mandibles. A tiny mouth ringed with dozens of wriggling palps like boneless fingers serves to manipulate the grotesque fragments of flesh that it dines upon. The two front legs have been turned into fighting weapons, edged with hooks and jagged serrations curling back towards the waiting mandibles. Above all rises a horrid stink of indescribable rot and foulness. A reek that reminds you of an opened cesspit or a charnel house.

Dwarf-like creature.description: The Dwarf-like creature is a queer creature, a product of some ill union between insect and dwarf. It looks like an over-muscled dwarf except for an extra set of long black "legs" that dangle from its midsection and a smooth, charcoal colored shell that shields its flesh body. Dragon Priest intercessor.description: A tall, male race is::S'Kra Mur, the intercessor is swathed in grey leather armor from neck to toe. A diagonally-patterned black and white tabard over the armor is emblazoned across the left breast with a dragon. Metal bracers adorn his wrists and several elegant, single-edged swords are stored across his body. He appears in his prime and the weight of years of experience shines from within slitted eyes.

Drowned one.description: According to folklore, Drowned Ones are the fate that awaits those who curse the gods with their last breath after falling victim to Drogor's temper. Unholy forces lurking in the ocean snatch the god-forsaken corpses and puppeteer them to some wicked end. This bloated corpse in particular features a warped posture as if slain mid-transformation.

This creature appears mostly humanoid, if one can somehow ignore the camouflaged fur that covers its body. You see an Elpalzi bowyer. The Elpalzi bowyer is in good shape. It is wearing a rugged leather thigh quiver, a simple leather helm reinforced with strips of bone, a tattered leather jerkin emblazoned in silver with a rearing dragon, a pair of sturdy leather boots. It is carrying some claw-tipped arrows, a crude mistwood longbow. An Elpalzi bowyer exclaims, "All who stand before us shall be slaughtered!" An Elpalzi bowyer murmers softly, "You'll all be taken care of if you submit to us. Do not be afraid. We treat our slaves well."

Drogorian stormrider.description: As long as an average Dwarf's height and as thick as one's neck, the Drogorian stormrider moves about with an exceptional natural fluidity. It has benign, jewel-like silvery eyes that almost belie its predatory posture. The sleek body is covered in nacreous black scales, exuding electricity from the flashing yellow spots patterned along its sides.

Dryad priestess.description: The dryad priestess stands a little taller than an average Dwarf. She has a lithe body with thin limbs that are a little longer than would be fitting for her size. A cluster of autumn-hued oak leaves comprises her "hair," flowing to the middle of her back. A faint expression of melancholy is on her face.

Elder blue-dappled prereni (1).description: A rather small species of deer, the prereni is unusual in that it will aggressively defend its territory. Standing about ten and a half hands high, it is characterized by its delicately pointed ears and a grey coat patterned with blued spots.

Elder blue-dappled prereni (2).description: A rather small species of deer, the prereni is unusual in that it will aggressively defend its territory. Standing about ten and a half hands high, it is characterized by its delicately pointed ears and a grey coat patterned with blued spots.

Elder Adan'f sorcerer.description: Introduced in Tuesday Tidings 9. Like all of the Adan'f race, the sorcerer vaguely resembles a large lizard, complete with reddish-black scales and forked tongue. Slitted golden eyes are set deeply into its narrow skull, over triple rows of gleaming pointed teeth. A long, sinuous neck leads down to a slender, almost frail, body. Its muscular tail is tipped with one gleaming, hook-shaped talon that's stained with gory remnants. The sorcerer wears a long hooded cloak of deep black cloth, its surface lumpy with concealed items. Cast many more spells than their younger mage counterparts and they're quite stealthy.

Elder Adan'f blademaster.description: Introduced in Tuesday Tidings 9. Spawn with a random weapon and have learned some new tricks to keep you off balance while being better at keeping their own.

Elder razortusk boar.description: Closely resembling his smaller domesticated cousin, the razortusk boar adds beady, bloodshot eyes and razor-sharp tusks to the normal porcine physique.

Elder storm geese.description: Introduced in Tuesday Tidings 66. Premium Only

Elite Adan'f spirit dancer.description: Like all of the Adan'f race, the spirit dancer vaguely resembles a large lizard, complete with blue-black scales and forked tongue. Slitted silver eyes are set deeply into its triangular skull, over triple rows of gleaming pointed teeth. A long, sinuous neck leads down to a graceful body, rippled with muscle. The spirit dancer's powerful legs give it great strength and speed, and its long curved tail lends it incredible balance.

Drogor avatar.description: Alive: The avatar is a hefty merman with the upper body of a Gor'Tog with bronze-green skin. His lower body is scaled in greyish black, tapering to a spiny tail. Ceaseless, powerful currents of ghostly indigo light flow in and out of his eyes, skin, and scales. Dead: The avatar is a hefty merman with the upper body of a Gor'Tog with bronze-green skin. His lower body is scaled in greyish black, tapering to a spiny tail.

Elder desert armadillo (2).description: Thick, articulated hide plating covers the desert armadillo from its dripping, twitchy snout to its barbed tail. Perfectly adapted to blend into a desert environment, the animal's coloration is a mottled patchwork of sand and tan. With powerful claws for digging protective burrows, a barbed tail, and flexible plating that allows the creature to roll itself up tightly, the armadillo appears well built to defend itself.

Elder hardened silverfish.description: Silverfish are table-sized creatures encased in a hard, silvery exoskeleton. Three tail-like appendages at the end of their abdomen look strong enough to shatter bone and their front legs sport a razor sharp edge. Mandible clattering incessantly, these are hive creatures and their primal instinct is to bring food to the nest. Any food.

Dryanoxie.description: The dryanoxie has a squat, broad-bodied frame covered in pale green skin mottled in irregular dappled patterns resembling natural camouflage. Reflective coppery eyes sit within a flattened, squashy face beneath a tangled patch of lush grass and a carpet of multihued wildflowers growing directly from its scalp. Layered wooden slats overlap across its body like weathered shingles, forming crude armor that shifts stiffly with movement. Thick pieces of bark are bound beneath its feet with braided grass lashings, creating rough, makeshift footwear.

Faenrae reaver.description: About five foot in height, the race is::faenrae reaver is a vicious creature with glowing green eyes and withered gray flesh. Its lips are curled back from its teeth to reveal sharp fangs, and its hands end in wickedly jagged claws. Clad in earthly armor, the faenrae reaver floats a few inches off the ground, but moves as if it touched the earth. A mane of flowing black hair flies behind it like a banner, ragged and tangled by the wind. Bowlegged and humanoid, the faenrae reaver stares at you with pure madness in its eyes and a crazed, drunken sneer on its lips.

Fire maiden.description: A fire maiden is a lithe, agile creature with ruddy skin and flowing red hair. Her bright, flashing sanguine eyes are filled with burning rage as she dances about in a ceaseless blur of motion. Beautiful in a charming manner, there is an obvious -- if subtle -- madness about the maiden that undermines her deceptively sweet, childlike nature.

Field goblin (1).description: Standing on two legs, the field goblin is somewhat small, like a Dwarf. It looks passive but wary.

Faenrae stalker.description: A cousin to the faenrae reaver, the race is::faenrae stalker is less ugly, but no less intimidating than its twisted relative. Night-black fur covers its body, causing it to blend easily into the comfort of shadows, and coal black eyes that offer no hint of white gaze back coldly at the world. A migrant from the Dark Hand, the stalker shows little mercy, and is infamous for its tendency to use "dirty tricks" when backed into a corner. Lithe and slender, the stalker has a fluid, unnerving way of moving as it floats just off the ground.

Emaciated umbramagus.description: The emaciated umbramagus is an unnatural and alien beast, apparent from its bodily structure. Two skeletal heads are mounted atop a barren ribcage, and four boney arms arch out in a radial pattern. Its legs are impossible to see, lost in the swirling confines of a shade-filled vortex which the thing uses as a means of locomotion.

Feral bone mastiff.description: Picked clean of all fleshy tissue by buzzards, maggots, or a combination of both, the skeletal hulk of a mastiff rises tall before you. Its feral canine body is unnaturally elongated and twisted into exaggerated knots, likely by the same force that animates it beyond Eylhaar's embrace. A sickly green light glistens within its empty eyesockets, a sign of its foul pact with some Necromantic entity.

Faenrae assassin.description: Garbed in black leather and a black cape, the assassin's only visible parts are withered flesh and glowing red eyes. Like its cousin, the Faenrae Stalker (as if such a thing could have family!), it floats slightly above the ground, but moves much more swiftly and with calculated purpose.

Elpalzi veteran.description: Standing near 10 feet tall, this Elpalzi rivals a Gor'Tog in both height and brawn, but far exceeds one in intellect. Rippling muscles cover its body, while its darting crystal green eyes gleam with intelligence. This creature appears mostly humanoid, if one can somehow ignore the camouflaged fur that covers its body.

Fell hog.description: The fell hog has a scruffy, squat body that is brownish-gray. An unpleasant odor hovers around the beast. You can make out maggots crawling in and out of gaping wounds on its dirty coat. Eyes gleaming with unnatural light glare from deep, sunken sockets.

Fell mage.description: Covered with armor from head to toe and wielding a large impressive weapon, the mage stares at you with glowing eyes, filled with greed for money and power. He is consumed completely with his desire, having sacrificed all to gain all.

Faenrae chanter.description: A cousin to the faenrae reaver, the race is::faenrae chanter stands close to six feet tall, with the broad, powerful shoulders of a formidable warrior. Deep-set crimson eyes stare out from the rugged, angular face, framed by a flowing mane of reddish hair. The skin of the the chanter is a dark gray and leathery, and gleaming claws wait at the end of long, spindly fingers.

Faenrae executioner.description: Like so many people who moved to The Crossing in the hopes of acquiring a new dream and a new life, the executioner is one of many who failed, having little choice but to take up the life of common scum just to get by in the world. From the way he eyes your money pouch, however, you're not sure exactly how much pity you can dish out to this person. After all, the executioner >did< make the decision to live his life this way...right?

Rippling muscles cover its body, while its darting crystal green eyes gleam with intelligence. Enraged tusky.description: Only the biggest, baddest boars are chosen to serve as the official mascot of the Gor'Tog clan that takes its name from the ferocious creature. This specimen is no exception, and it looks especially nasty now that it has returned from the dead to wreak havoc upon all who tread across its sacred home field. About the size of a grizzly bear and just as hairy, the smelly swine tosses its meaty head around in a battle gesture to fully display its two humongous tusks. Foam drips from the beast's mouth at the mere thought of impaling the next oblivious trespasser.

Farshel sibowen.description: The farshel sibowen is a blob of darkness, with swirling rope-like tendrils. Fearsome claws form and reform from the intangible dark, and it ceaselessly seeks warmth and light to take to its embrace. Eyeless and featureless, it nevertheless senses your presence and and with cold delight seeks to devour you.

It is wearing a pair of sturdy leather boots, a tattered leather jerkin emblazoned in silver with a rearing dragon, a simple leather helm reinforced with strips of bone, a rugged leather thigh quiver. It is carrying a crude mistwood longbow, some claw-tipped arrows.
