It is wearing some rugged black leather boots, a tattered leather jerkin emblazoned in silver with a rearing dragon, a simple leather helm reinforced with strips of bone. It is carrying an engraved steel round axe.

Festival bandit.description: The festive bandit appears fairly typical, but he has a tattoo of a jeweled dagger piercing a golden Kronar visible just under his sleeve. Outfitted for survival and quick getaways, he also bears the scars of one living in derelict conditions. This one has plenty of experience under his belt.

Endrus serpent.description: The endrus serpent is a leafy amalgam of woody detritus held together by snarls of vines and creepers. Despite its motley composition, the lithe serpent moves with reptilian grace invisible against the surrounding vegetation. Superficially resembling a large snake, this construct is the length of a tall Elf. The creature is constantly changing and reforming, but it tends to have a sinuous, serpentine body. Its maw is crowded with jagged teeth, and its eyes glow with eerie incandescence.

Field goblin (2).description: Standing on two legs, the field goblin is somewhat small, like a Dwarf. It looks passive but wary.

Feral banyakea.description: Though it appears to have once been a normal four-legged creature, the twisted banyakea now has numerous extra arms and legs that appear grafted onto its torso, which is twisted from the weight of all the extra limbs. Though most of them look useless and simply hang off its body, several of the limbs move and writhe as if alive. The twisted banyakea also appears to be in a great deal of pain, its movements jerky and twisting constantly.

Fibrous clay slayer.description: ==Recall== Mass-crafted from a set of molds, the clay slayer has been expertly cast, fired, assembled, and imbued with purpose. Unlike its more simple brethren, the clay slayer is capable of advanced planning and task execution, methodically working either alone or as a group to ensure the completion of its task. Many have foolishly underestimated the constructions' capabilities. Though its creation has been long lost to history, the armor design and embellishments bear similarities to certain elements of the Empire of the Seven Pointed Star. Furthermore, the outmoded invocation of the Anther's Call spell is reminiscent of those early mages' forays into the old pattern. The result of the spell is identical to the modern version, and the clay slayer is certainly capable of taking advantage of the effect on its opponents. They are known to cast casts spell::Anther's Call. They are known to carry loot in locked boxes.

Essence of the Depths.description: Seeming to drink all available light, the Essence stands as an utterly black and absolutely featureless humanoid silhouette, more a visible absence, without any evident front, side, or back. Standing as tall as a Gor'Tog, with long slender arms and legs, nothing can be seen within the outline of this strange being. The silhouette billows with strange no-color fumes, blown in random, shifting directions as if caught in a strong wind, and it casts about with malevolent intent.

Ember bull.description: Although superficially resembling the farmyard animal, closer examination shows that the comparison is much like that between a small campfire and a raging forest fire. Not only does an ember bull's size dwarf that of the average bull, but flickers of flame run along its deep red hide and run along the ember bull's horns while clouds of ash and cinders are exhaled through the nostrils of the ember bull.

Ember bull (2).description: Although superficially resembling the farmyard animal, closer examination shows that the comparison is much like that between a small campfire and a raging forest fire. Not only does an ember bull's size dwarf that of the average bull, but flickers of flame run along its deep red hide and run along the ember bull's horns while clouds of ash and cinders are exhaled through the nostrils of the ember bull. This premium version has a creature level range of 70-74 found up a hillside trail in the northern part of the standard ember bull zone.

Ferocious foothill fighter.description: Nomadic life in the rugged northern steppes has given the foothill fighter leathery skin, sun-bleached hair, and a near constant squint against the harsh brilliance of the open sky. She wears robes of richly dyed fabric that drape and snap in the ceaseless breeze of her mountain home.

Etes drone.description: In a very basic sort of way, the etes drone resembles an ant -- six legs, antennae, three body sections. Its size, however, is closer to a very large raccoon's, and it has additional bodyparts that the common tiny ant lacks. Its proboscis, for example, drips a viscous green fluid that has dyed the surrounding husk a lighter shade of green. The unnatural extension makes the etes drone seem more like a mad mage's experiment, and its undead state is somehow less jarring in that context. Grotesque flaps of withered flesh can sometimes be seen -- no doubt to assist in their hauling duties.

Emerald claw troll.description: Wild and feral eyes hide behind the emerald hair that drapes over the troll's face. Its forward leaning posture and loud chittering shows the madness that must be in the mind of this pitiful creature. Each finger is tipped with a small, viciously curved claw, honed to a sharp point. The claw troll's emerald-colored hide is covered in a fine layer of mineral dust, giving it a dull, muted appearance that is offset by the occasional glint of light reflecting off the claw troll's claws and teeth.

Ghoul.description: The ghoul looks like some sick parody of mankind perpetrated by a mad god. Standing over six feet tall, its mud-caked skin is pale grey splotched with green. Its torso and limbs are elongated and bone thin. A pair of evil red eyes stare out at you from within its distorted hairless skull, above a grinning mouth lined with rows of jagged teeth.

Footpad (creature1).description: Like so many people who moved to Shard in the hopes of acquiring a new dream and a new life, the footpad is one of many who failed, having little choice but to take up the life of common scum just to get by in the world. From the way he eyes your money pouch, however, you're not sure exactly how much pity you can dish out to this person. After all, the footpad did make the decision to live his life this way...right?

Frostweaver.description: The frostweaver is a slender faerie woman, with pale blue-white skin, silvery hair and tilted crystal blue eyes. According to legend, a lovely woman once rejected Idon's advances. In revenge, his curse turned her into the first frostweaver, a creature of ice, unable to care about any living being. Whether the legend is true or not, it would be hard to mistake the being before you for a mortal woman.

Fire sprite.description: A fire sprite is a lithe, agile creature with ruddy skin and flowing red hair. Her bright, flashing sanguine eyes are filled with burning rage as she dances about in a ceaseless blur of motion. Beautiful in a charming manner, there is an obvious -- if subtle -- madness about the sprite that undermines her deceptively sweet, childlike nature.

Giant black leucro (1).description: Jet black and looking very much like a giant wolf, the black leucro is half as tall as a normal sized human. Its eyes burn with a fire that suggests that it is more than an overgrown wolf. Something otherwordly seems to burn within its soul. Though often appearing in large groups, it seems to move with an independence that seems to go beyond the pack mentality of normal wolves. Perhaps that is for the best since you are almost certain that if they learned or desired to act in unison, you would be dead now.

Forest geni (1).description: Extraordinary pale green eyes catch yours as a forest geni dances from foot to foot before you. Not much taller than an adult halfling, its delicate pointed ears are adorned with tiny copper bells which accentuate the faint greenish tinge of its skin. Rough clothing formed of leaves and bark cover his stocky body. Its eyes constantly scan the area, sometimes flashing with rage and other times holding a glint of amusement.

Gaunt shadow master.description: The color of the space between the stars, the shadow master appears vaguely skeletal, displaying not only ribs but a skull-like head. Though the master is ever-shifting and apparently incorporeal, several distinctive features stand out, such as the lack of a lower jaw and the gleaming double row of solid-looking ivory fangs. Even more prominent are the sabre-length talons it wields on the ends of its wispy, black arms.

Gelv cyclops.description: Clothed in a patchwork hide loincloth the gelv cyclops is a frightful sight indeed. Nearly thirty feet tall and equipped with two huge, powerful forearms the cyclops is a very stout foe. Its most curious aspect, however, isn't its gigantic size, but rather the lone eye which consumes most of its forehead. The eye seems to watch you no matter where you move.

Frost angiswaerd.description: Shaded in an off color white except for a deep bluish tint along the tip of its tail and snout, the frost angiswaerd resembles a large, hearty serpent, easily twenty paces long. A thick mane of ragged hair surrounds its head and trails a short distance down its spine, odd for a reptile but perhaps a magical product of the icy climates it prefers.

Giant blade spider.description: The blade spider is covered with thick chitinous plates, appearing not unlike a suit of armor with numerous legs. Sword-shaped blades run along the back of the spider's front appendages and multi-faceted eyes peer quizzically from over a set of vice-like barbed mandibles.

Gargantuan bone golem.description: A hideous amalgam of shattered, twisted, and fused bone, the fearsome hulk before you rises to the height of several Gor'Togs. Clearly no natural beast possesses a skeletal structure as horrific as this - with uneven limbs formed of irregular, contorted lengths of flesh-stripped bone. Its claws are incongruent and jagged, bearing the unmistakable crimson stain of dried blood. Only a Necromancer of considerable power and vileness could meld the deceased bodies of so many beasts into such a horrific construct.

Frostweyr bear.description: This is one very large beast. It has an extremely thick coat of course white hair and a long snout with a black nose at the end. Small icicles hang off the ridge of the mouth and chunks of snow are embedded everywhere in the fur. Of course the predominate features are the large sharp teeth and huge claws attached to the paws. Most likely used to dig into the ice or tear its current prey apart easily.

Forest bandit.description: The forest bandit is a short Elothean man with long, tangled hair that falls in oily dreadlocks around his face. Pinched with hunger, he is gaunt and feral in appearance beneath the dirt that obscures his features. Altogether, a desperate villain indeed!

Gargantuan korograth.description: Near mythic in proportion, the gargantuan korograth towers shoulder-high to a mature ironwood and propels its muscular bulk forward on four stocky legs, each with the girth of an adult mammoth. Twisted black horns, wrapped with several layers of rusted razor-wire, jut forth from a massive bone frill that encircles its triangular head. The gargantuan korograth's cumbersome, heavily-muscled frame is covered with a thick armor of burnt orange and black-striped scales, hung with rotting corpses and dying prisoners crying out for the release of death. Interlocking plates of greasy, black bone armor surmount the length of its spine and upper flanks, ending in row upon row of wicked spikes near the tip of its sinuous tail. A complex conglomeration of ropes, pulleys, chains and straps firmly secure a miniature stronghold onto the back to the gargantuan korograth. Crimson and purple banners dangle from several tiered platforms of wood and steel that surround the main interior structure, guarded by the hawk-eyed archers perched atop it.

Ghoul crow.description: The ghoul crow is a wretched bird, far more troublesome than the the typical crow. Its beady eyes cloaked in a disheveled mass of grey and black feathers pierce into your own with the cold, unfeeling grip of a lost soul. Its razor-sharp beak snaps wildly about with sheer bloodlust, no doubt the implement of slaughter to many a squirrel (and errant adventurer) before.

Forager goblin.description: Standing on two legs, the forager goblin is somewhat small, like a Dwarf. It looks passive but wary.

Giant adder.description: Nearly as wide as a full grown human, it's also much longer and it often measures 15 feet in length. Fierce, deadly and the foe of all who meet it, it seems at times to express almost human qualities. Some legends suggest that the giant adder was indeed among the races of our kind but were enchanted into the poisonous, hateful thing you now see.

Fractured revivified mutt.description: Picked clean of all fleshy tissue by buzzards, maggots, or a combination of both, the skeletal hulk of a mastiff rises tall before you. Its feral canine body is unnaturally elongated and twisted into exaggerated knots, likely by the same force that animates it beyond Eylhaar's embrace. A sickly green light glistens within its empty eyesockets, a sign of its foul pact with some Necromantic entity.

Gestalt draugen (creature).description: Elongated, blood-tainted bones bound with a lattice of resinous ligament concoct what appears to be a horrific hybrid of canine and feline forms. Most lethal attributes of both have been picked out and combined into an indefatigable killing machine, replete with scythe-like claws and razor teeth. The abomination stands seven-feet tall and moves bipedally with some degree of cunning, slinking from shadow to shadow. Its Necromantic animating force has manifested as a bilious green phosphorescence which gleams from within its bones.

Folsi immola.description: The immola resembles a troll in build, but the similarities end there. Large, curling black horns protrude from its broad forehead, and dark ridges shade beady black eyes. The most outstanding feature is his boil-covered skin. Streaks of fiery-colored veins sit close to the surface, rupturing occasionally and leaking the immola's overheated blood. Between this and his penchant for violence, the immola is not a pretty sight.

Frail darkened silhouette.description: Roughly humanoid, the darkened silhouette is capped by a twisted skull of the deepest shadow. It drifts a few feet off the ground, its legs nothing more than an ebony and grey mist, but its arms are tipped with jagged-looking blades that appear all too sharp and solid.

Gam chaga.description: About the size of an adult Halfling, a gam chaga is hardly more than a mouth with arms and legs, at the end of which reside tiny hands and feet with jagged claws. The whole of the creature's body is comprised of opaque salt crystals, which grind against one another as it moves. Veins of murky red blood ooze just beneath its saline carapace, and rows of fiendish needle-sharp teeth snap erratically as its eyeless head swivels in all directions, seeking flesh to rend and bones to shatter.

Ghastly behemoth.description: Made from a foul-smelling substance black as pitch, the behemoth is animated by an unknown, magical force. Huge yellow eyes stare down from its oversized sockets, appearing like smooth and uniform spheres rather than anything that could be called natural. Constantly searching for new prey, the behemoth hunts down the living, and though a strong magic masks its nature its shape and movements hint at the dreaded curse of undeath.

Gentle marmozel.description: Standing on two legs the gentle marmozel is humanoid size. It looks back at you, a bit agitated.

Fledgling forest gryphon (2).description: Smaller than a standard gryphon, the forest gryphon has the body of a bobcat with its fluffy bobbed tail and plush tawny fur, while soft brown and white feathers cover the forequarters and wings. The creature's cat-slitted orange eyes are flecked with crimson veins around the pupil. Long white feathers bar the creature's wings, and its hooked beak snaps irritably at you.

Fledgling forest gryphon (1).description: Smaller than a standard gryphon, the forest gryphon has the body of a bobcat with its fluffy bobbed tail and plush tawny fur, while soft brown and white feathers cover the forequarters and wings. The creature's cat-slitted orange eyes are flecked with crimson veins around the pupil. Long white feathers bar the creature's wings, and its hooked beak snaps irritably at you.

Giant Dergatian spawn.description: Rivaling a mammoth in size, the Dergatian spawn resembles a hairless star-nosed mole which has crawled out of some deranged nightmare. Its disturbingly translucent skin, while offering glimpses to the workings of the massive internal organs, appears more than thick and resilient enough to protect the beast. Dirt-caked claws as long as javelins scratch restlessly at the ground, carving up great grooves wherever it goes.

Flame weaver.description: A flame weaver is a lithe, agile creature with ruddy skin and flowing red hair. Her bright, flashing sanguine eyes are filled with burning rage as she dances about in a ceaseless blur of motion. Beautiful in a charming manner, there is an obvious -- if subtle -- madness about the weaver that undermines her deceptively sweet, childlike nature.

Forest drake.description: The forest drake is a leafy amalgam of woody detritus, held together by snarls of vines and creepers. Despite its motley composition, the drake moves with lithe, reptilian grace, its body nearly invisible against the surrounding vegetation. Resembling a small angiswaerd, the construct is the length of a full-grown Gor'Tog and is protected by a multitude bark scales that cover its body from snout to tail. The creature is constantly changing and reforming, but it tends to have a sinuous, low-slung body supported by four sturdy legs. Its maw is crowded with razor-sharp teeth, and its eyes glow with eerie incandescence.

Gestalt void midge.description: The midges briefly separate into a dense, amorphous cloud. When they gather together again, you notice that the void midge looks healthier than before. Formed from an amalgamation of thousands of smaller midges, the void midge hovers malevolently nearby. The creatures comprising its void-black body are arrayed so that the whole slightly resembles one gigantic individual, complete with six segmented legs, flickering wings, and razor-sharp claws. The group seems possessed of some rudimentary gestalt intelligence, as the creatures move with a coordinated grace and cold, analytical cunning.

Gatekeeper skeleton.description: Standing on two legs, the gatekeeper skeleton is humanoid size. It is obviously aggressive and looking for a fight.

Footpad (creature4).description: Like so many people who moved to The Crossing in the hopes of acquiring a new dream and a new life, the footpad is one of many who failed, having little choice but to take up the life of common scum just to get by in the world. From the way he eyes your money pouch, however, you're not sure exactly how much pity you can dish out to this person. After all, the footpad did make the decision to live his life this way...right?

Giant bear.description: The giant bear's hypnotic effect of swinging its head from side to side is dispelled when you realize that you have encountered a foe with sharp claws, powerful jaws, and quick reflexes.

Forager ghoul.description: The ghoul is a loathesome thing. Though perhaps a similar height to a short Human if it stood upon straight legs, it is bent and hunched from its eternal grubbing in graves, charnel pits, and other unsavory places for its sustenance. Dark grey skin covered with mold and rot covers a bony but powerful frame. Deep-set eyes constantly search for prey, while a wide nose snuffles every breeze for the taint of rot it craves. Faster and more cunning than its simpler kin, the ghoul is not content with waiting for prey, but will go out and search for it, straying far from home, wherever or whenever that may once have been.

Forager wight.description: The wight is a loathesome thing. Though perhaps a similar height to a short Human if it stood upon straight legs, it is bent and hunched from its eternal grubbing in graves, charnel pits, and other unsavory places for its sustenance. Dark grey skin covered with mold and rot covers a bony but powerful frame. Deep-set eyes constantly search for prey, while a wide nose snuffles every breeze for the taint of rot it craves. Faster and more cunning than its simpler kin, the wight is not content with waiting for prey, but will go out and search for it, straying far from home, wherever or whenever that may once have been.

Giant black leucro (2).description: Jet black and looking very much like a giant wolf, the black leucro is half as tall as a normal sized human. Its eyes burn with a fire that suggests that it is more than an overgrown wolf. Something otherwordly seems to burn within its soul. Though often appearing in large groups, it seems to move with an independence that seems to go beyond the pack mentality of normal wolves. Perhaps that is for the best since you are almost certain that if they learned or desired to act in unison, you would be dead now.

Forest geni (2).description: Extraordinary pale green eyes catch yours as a forest geni dances from foot to foot before you. Not much taller than an adult halfling, its delicate pointed ears are adorned with tiny copper bells which accentuate the faint greenish tinge of its skin. Rough clothing formed of leaves and bark cover his stocky body. Its eyes constantly scan the area, sometimes flashing with rage and other times holding a glint of amusement.

Frostcrone.description: The shambling frostcrone was once a slender faerie woman. Her hair is caked with mud, and her eyes are clouded and unseeing. Still, the frosty being is preserved and animated through some unnatural force so that she can continue to serve someone or something's purpose. Cursed in life, she remains doubly so in undeath.

Gale drake.description: Small but thick scaled plates cover the drake from head to claws while thicker, angular plates descend along the creature's back. His tail swishes from side to side, leaving flickering sparks of electricity in its wake. With a mouth full of razor-sharp teeth and quill-like barbs protruding menacingly from the tip of his tail, the drake is built for survival -- either by overpowering his foes or enduring and outlasting their attacks.

Fluffy stolb.description: Superficially resembling a normal cottontail, a tan fluffy stolb is much much larger while sporting long, curved, sharp teeth jutting from its gaping maw. Each ear has tiny arcs of electricity running along the razor-tipped edges, and the powerful limbs end in knifelike claws. Beady eyes glare at the world with unending hostility.

Frost troll.description: A towering humanoid figure, the frost troll is covered in a layer of icy snow and armored with jagged plates of frost-laden ice. Its angular features and piercing, soulless eyes give it a menacing appearance, while its frosty breath swirls about its head. The troll's build is surprisingly lithe, hinting at formidable combat prowess. It moves with a predatory grace, as if always ready to strike. At any moment, the troll could disperse into a whirling funnel of ice and snow, only to reform elsewhere in the area.

Granite gargoyle.description: Composed of rock, the gargoyle is a statue come to life at the hand of an ambitious mage. Mostly irate at the world and grumbling to itself about anything from the state of the Elven nation to the weather, the gargoyle does not look so much inclined to fight as it is to curl up in a corner and look frightening. Still, it knows its task as a protector of its creator's domain, and will do its best to keep invaders from treading on its turf.

Glutinous lipopod.description: The glutinous lipopod is a massive worm which normally spends its time in the waters of large lakes. It ventures onto land only when seeking nourishment. Lipopod have been known to decimate the living organism counts in bodies of water, but fortunately can only survive in brackish or tainted environments. Having a basic, worm-like form, these milky, nearly-transparent creatures absorb their food through osmosis. They can wrap their bodies around their prey and literally digest them through their epidermis. With no real eyes, nose or mouth, their skin has evolved into one massive sensory unit. Their pea-sized brains are located in the forward-leading part of their bodies. The various irregularities on their skin, which you might call nodules, ooze a thick, smelly slime which is quite caustic. In the water, this slime protects their bodies in the cold depths, but on land, it does little more than burn the ground like a strong acid. Despite a lack of vocal cords, the glutinous lipopod manages to emit a primitive, high-pitched squealing sound. It does this by manipulating several small portions of its body into air pockets, which it then squeezes with a kind of shivering motion. All in all, it's a pretty disgusting and goopy creature.

Grass eel.description: No more than eighteen inches long, this grass eel has a nasty disposition entirely out of proportion with its size. In fact it looks more like a green bootlace than anything else. The eel more than makes up in speed and agility what it lacks in strength, however, and a score of bites from a score of grass eels would not be a pleasant experience.

Giant wolf spider.description: Supported on multiple legs, the wolf spider is humanoid size. It is obviously aggressive and looking for a fight.

Golden pard.description: The golden pard is a large cat of sleek build with powerful leaping muscles. Dark enough to disappear into shadows and patient enough to wait for the perfect opportunity to pounce, it watches and waits for the weaknesses of its prey. Golden-green eyes glitter in the blackness of its form, but once you have noticed those eyes, most assuredly you are already considered a snack.

Glistening scythewing larva.description: The scythewing larva looks much like a large worm, roughly the size (and shape) of a small Halfling. Its dusky blue exoskeleton is soft and fleshy, covered in a thick layer of gelatinous slime. Two small yet razor sharp mandibles protrude from a tiny circular opening in what you can only assume is its head.

Greater sluagh.description: The greater sluagh is a foul-smelling, foul-tempered, foul-looking beast that makes a mother-in-law seem positively angelic. Seven feet tall, musclebound, and wearing some kind of ragged, odiferous hide over its own none too lovely grey skin, it stares with bloodshot eyes and an evil leer. It is a living creature rather than an undead one, though you can't imagine it being any uglier or meaner were it undead. It seems much more intelligent than the lesser variety, looming with a greater strength, and moving deftly about with agile precision.

Greater shadow hound.description: A feral being of pure shadow essence, this beast vaguely resembles a canine with greatly exaggerated features. Its massive maw bears several tusk-size fangs that hook downward, gleaming with unadulterated malice. Its eyes blaze with an unearthly silver flame, casting a pale glow upon the area and highlighting its sinuous, muscular body. Tendrils of inky black mist trail behind it as it moves, dancing lazily from its nostrils.

Grave worm.description: Covered in wrinkled grey flesh, the grave worm resembles a large slug. It is only a superficial similarity, however, since slugs lack the ringed mouth of sharpened teeth as well as the exoskeleton-encased hind quarters and vestigial limbs that this monstrosity has. A foul stench rises from the worm, the source no doubt the disgusting dripping mess that runs off its form.

Golden scaled atik'et.description: The scaled atik'et resembles a slightly built S'Kra Mur woman with golden scales and a fiery crest atop her head. Flickering flames dance back and forth from finger to finger, and her lips are parted in a soft, hissing croon.

Giant blight bat.description: The blight bat's beady red eyes blaze with an unreasoning hatred and hunger. Large ears swivel this way and that, alert to every noise that might signify prey. Scruffy black fur covers the creature's body and its dark grey wings are tinged crimson by the complex network of veins running through the parchment-thin membranes. Although the bat is no larger than a kestrel, its swiftness, sharp fangs and curved claws combined with its ferocity are enough to give one pause.

Greater skeleton.description: Standing on two legs, the greater skeleton is humanoid size. It is obviously aggressive and looking for a fight.

Gold-taloned elder forest gryphon.description: Smaller than a standard gryphon, the forest gryphon has the body of a bobcat with its fluffy bobbed tail and plush tawny fur, while soft brown and white feathers cover the forequarters and wings. The creature's cat-slitted orange eyes are flecked with crimson veins around the pupil. The golden talons on its forefeet mark it as an elder among the forest gryphons.

Giant wasp.description: Far larger than its common cousins, the giant wasp hovers malevolently nearby, its multifaceted eyes fixed on yours.

Greater ghoul raven.description: The ghoul raven is a wretched bird, far more troublesome than the the typical raven. Its beady eyes cloaked in a disheveled mass of grey and black feathers pierce into your own with the cold, unfeeling grip of a lost soul. Its razor-sharp beak snaps wildly about with sheer bloodlust, no doubt the implement of slaughter to many a squirrel (and errant adventurer) before.

Graverobber (2).description: Scraping a living off the misfortune of its unsuspecting victims, the graverobber spends its life delving into long forgotten tombs and crypts to plunder the untold wealth of treasure lurking within the shadows. Faded black rags covered in countless layers of dirt and grime outline the graverobber's lanky build, sweeping wildly around its stooped frame with every restrained movement. Emotionless eyes gaze outward from the sallow features of its face, partially hidden behind some dark cloth drawn tightly over its mouth and nose. Wrapped in frayed layers of black cloth, long spidery fingers bear wide curling scars that cover its ghostly white flesh, similar in pallor to that of a sun bleached corpse. Its long greasy mane of black hair has been pulled into a frayed ponytail at the back of its head, the tangle of lice-ridden locks resting easily upon its narrow shoulder.

Giant blight ogre.description: The blight ogre is big and mean, clearly a cousin of the warm climate ogres. With red eyes, yellowing tusks, a warty nose and thick, mottled hide the color of old bruises, he certainly isn't going to win any beauty contests.

Gorbesh enchanter.description: Behind the concealment of his dark robe, this hulking enchanter surveys his surounds. The careful movements of his limbs suggests untold decades of campaign experience, and great skill at doing his job better than any other living thing.

Gorbesh captain.description: Standing on two legs the Gorbesh Captain big. It is obviously agressive and looking for a fight. [sic]

Giant snow hawk.description: Looking back at you is a massive bird of prey with snow-white feathers speckled with taupe. With a wingspan nearly seven Tog-lengths across, the hawk flies great distances from its nesting grounds in the snow-capped mountain peaks down to the forest canopy, where it hunts. Despite its great size, the hawk's quick, sensitive motions and deep black eyes communicate a litheness and intelligence that make it a feared predator.

Gorbesh line soldier.description: Standing on two legs the Gorbesh Line Soilder big. It is obviously agressive and looking for a fight. [sic]

Gorbesh commander.description: Standing on two legs the Gorbesh Commander big. It is obviously agressive and looking for a fight. [sic]

Gorbesh mage.description: There is something certainly frightening about this large humanoid creature. It facial and body features hidden behind massive armor and helm, its slow deliberate motions combined with its apparent lack of fear convince you it is bred for one purpose and one purpose only: killing!

Glass construct.description: Before you stands a glass construct, formed of naught but blood and glass. Carnage seems to roll from the creature as it gazes about, its silence only broken by the slow dripping of blood from its horrid body.

Giant mechanical mouse.description: Although superficially resembling a gigantic mouse, the mechanical mouse is clearly a machine. It moves, about on large wheels set underneath the dome-like metallic body that emits constant machine sounds.

Goblin zombie.description: The zombie goblin at first appears to just be a normal goblin, but flesh is peeling off of its body and its equipment is missing or in dire need of repair. Unfortunately, this just makes it smell even worse than a normal goblin. Its eyes glow a dim red with some sort of weak unholy power, and its limbs twitch in jerky movement due to its rigor mortis. It seems to be scanning the area looking for live meat to consume.

Gigantic lachmate (1).description: Resembling nothing more than an ambulatory rubbish heap, the gigantic lachmate is covered in leaves and other trash. Small extensions of the ooze within form feelers that allow it to grab at its surroundings.

Gigantic lachmate (2).description: Resembling nothing more than an ambulatory rubbish heap, the gigantic lachmate is covered in leaves and other trash. Small extensions of the ooze within form feelers that allow it to grab at its surroundings.

Gnarled fendryad (1).description: The fendryad is an emaciated faerie woman with dark, wrinkled skin, faintly glowing green eyes and skeletal leaves tangled in her sodden hair. According to legend, these creatures of the swamps and fens were once dryads, tied to the trees, until the coming of Man "tamed" the forests and drove the gentle creatures to death... or to madness. Evidently the fendryad belong to the latter class, for the glowing green eyes betray hatred and cunning without a trace of sanity.

Glazed clay slayer.description: ==Recall== Mass-crafted from a set of molds, the clay slayer has been expertly cast, fired, assembled, and imbued with purpose. Unlike its more simple brethren, the clay slayer is capable of advanced planning and task execution, methodically working either alone or as a group to ensure the completion of its task. Many have foolishly underestimated the constructions' capabilities. Though its creation has been long lost to history, the armor design and embellishments bear similarities to certain elements of the Empire of the Seven Pointed Star. Furthermore, the outmoded invocation of the Anther's Call spell is reminiscent of those early mages' forays into the old pattern. The result of the spell is identical to the modern version, and the clay slayer is certainly capable of taking advantage of the effect on its opponents. They are known to cast casts spell::Anther's Call. They are known to carry loot in locked boxes.

Jackal (creature).description: Lean and covered with short fur, the jackal is a predatorial beast of the canine family. Wolfish in nature and greatly exaggerated for its cowardly tendencies, the jackal roams its territory looking for leftover carrion or weaker living prey to savage and consume for its daily meals.

Heggarangi boar.description: The heggarangi boar is a huge wild beast with large, wicked tusks and coarse black hair. It glares out at the world through maniacal, bloodshot eyes, snorting and squealing and stamping its hooves with rage.

Grizzled red leucro.description: Covered in russet red fur and looking very much like a giant wolf, the red leucro is half as tall as a normal sized human. Its eyes burn with a fire that suggests it is much more than just an overgrown wolf. Something otherwordly seems to burn within its soul. Though often appearing in large groups, it moves with an independence that seems to go beyond the pack mentality of normal wolves. Perhaps that is for the best since you are almost certain that if they learned or desired to act in unison, you would be dead now.

Heggarangi frog.description: This is a rather large frog, with slimy skin and big beady eyes. It looks at you as if it thought you might be lunch!

Immature firecat.description: The immature firecat is a large cat of sleek build with powerful leaping muscles that ripple beneath its thick black coat. Flames flicker above its tufted ears, and its eyes shift from red to gold to blue as it watches, waiting for the perfect opportunity to pounce.

Gypsy marauder.description: Cavalier, dashingly-dressed and filled with the wild blood of the gypsy, the marauder cuts an impressive figure despite his penchant for murder and mayhem.

Inkhorne.description: The majestic Inkhorne is a large stag with an impressive set of antlers. It appears to be passive but could be dangerous if provoked.

Icy blue ghast.description: Shimmering shards of pale blue ice borne by rapidly swirling winds form a volatile mantle that shrouds the skeletal frame of the blue ghast. Moving with grace and speed despite its frozen armor, its empty eyes shine with a brilliant sapphirine luminescence. You can just barely make out the outline of fist-size rock hovering within its chest cavity, where a mortal's heart would lie.

Juvenile desert armadillo (1).description: Thick, articulated hide plating covers the desert armadillo from its dripping, twitchy snout to its barbed tail. Perfectly adapted to blend into a desert environment, the animal's coloration is a mottled patchwork of sand and tan. With powerful claws for digging protective burrows, a barbed tail, and flexible plating that allows the creature to roll itself up tightly, the armadillo appears well built to defend itself.

Hulking black barghest.description: A hulking black barghest resembles a shaggy-coated black dog, but its true nature is revealed by its cat-like slitted blood-red eyes and the smoking footprints it leaves behind. Its muscles ripple with faint silvery threads in the darkness. Enormous for a dog, its head comes up to your chest.

Grey and tan mottled westanuryn.description: Barely two feet long and made of dense chiton and sinew, the westanuryn resembles an oversized, nightmarish scorpion, right down to the vicious looking stinger held aloft in perpetual readiness. Lined along its front claws are jagged armor plates, most likely used to burrow through sand and dirt at speed, and provide additional protection from struggling prey to the front.

Jeol moradu.description: The jeol moradu stands well over five times the height of a large human with pale skin and white hair. His beard looks like giant icicles hanging halfway down his broad chest.

Isundjen conjurer.description: The Isundjen resembles a race association is::Merelew, perverted and disfigured by the arcane arts. Deep grey fish-like scales cover the surface of its body, though wide strips are missing, particularly notable around its eyes and mouth. Its head is lumpy and misshapen, as if it had been crushed and reassembled, and the webs between its fingers and toes are little more than thin membranes marred with scar tissue and holes. Completing the malicious appearance is its perpetual scowl, with which it displays the jagged shards one would call teeth, and piercing blood-red eyes.

Grey clay mage.description: Crafted by some unknown mage, the clay mage is a life-sized representation of a robed spellcaster, cast in some sort of hardened clay. Its face is beautiful and perfect but also completely expressionless and unmoving, and the construct moves in a graceful but unnatural manner, not unlike a puppet pulled by strings. Despite its unnatural movements, it seems vaguely aware of its surroundings, its eyes glowing with a magical light.

Grey clay soldier.description: Crafted by some unknown mage, the clay soldier is a life-sized representation of an actual warrior, cast in some sort of hardened clay. Its face is beautiful and perfect but also completely expressionless and unmoving, and the construct moves in a rather artificial manner not unlike a puppet pulled by strings. Despite its unnatural movements, it seems more than capable of handling itself in a fight.

Grey clay archer.description: Crafted by some unknown mage, the clay archer is a life-sized representation of a ranger, cast in some sort of hardened clay. Its face is beautiful and perfect but also completely expressionless and unmoving, and the construct moves in a graceful but unnatural manner, not unlike a puppet pulled by strings. Despite its unnatural movements, it seems more than capable of handling a bow and arrow. NOTE: They have strong defense against puncture damage. Impact is best damage type to use against them.

Kather shaman.description: Though vaguely human in form, the has evolved from years underground to need very little light. His elderly form is slightly hunched, though his eerily white eyes peer out from under his hood of his long, flowing robes which cover his body almost completely. In his pale, bony hand, he holds a vial of naptha, at the ready to cast a spell at a moment's notice.

Hideous horned black steed.description: A wild, bulky night-black horse of some foreign kind, the steed's most prominent feature is the tortuous and malformed horn jutting from its forehead. In spite of its matted coat and overall disheveled appearance, it looks incredibly strong and swift. A bony wind wretch/ragged wind hag is sitting astride the black steed.

Juvenile wyvern.description: Standing upon two muscular hind legs at nearly half the height of a fully mature wyvern, the juvenile wyvern soaks in its surroundings with keen intelligence coupled with the feral hunger and unbridled strength the wyverns have been renowned to possess. Instead of arms, two large black wings rest atop the muscular shoulders of the juvenile wyvern, unable to yet support its weight during any extended flight. Its muscular body is covered in a thick armor of rippling scales, the jagged scars of past battles crisscrossing along its back and flanks. Rows of razor-sharp spikes follow the ridges of its neck and back to end at the tip of its broad tail, which is barbed and dripping with venom.

Ice archon.description: Standing over twenty feet tall, an ice archon is a being made entirely out of ice and snow, except for its eyes which glow an eerie pale blue color and appear to be the source of its animation. Snow and ice constantly sheds from its massive frame, showering to the ground in waves. It stares forward with an uncaring gaze, although there is a deep-rooted malevolence in its ethereal eyes.

Haunt.description: Closely resembling a ghost, insubstantial haunt is hard to make out. Basically humanoid in form and shape, its body twists and shudders as if in excruciating pain. At times it takes on some solidity, and the vague form of a person in torment can be seen. While its body may be nothing but a twisted mass of essence, its teeth and claws look real enough, willing and able to rend your soul from your body!

Green sewer eel.description: No more than eighteen inches long, this sewer eel has a nasty disposition entirely out of proportion with its size. In fact it looks more like a green bootlace than anything else. The eel more than makes up in speed and agility what it lacks in strength, however, and a score of bites from a score of sewer eels would not be a pleasant experience. *note: possibly a cousin to the Grass eel

Harawep's Spider.description: Alive: With almost impossibly thin legs compared to the body that it holds up, the enormous spider moves with a speed and grace that belies its origins. Narrow bands of white cross the legs in even stripes, and small scars mark numerous past battles. A bright red hourglass marks its long and sleek black abdomen, and venom drips from its long fangs at it stares with eight pitch black eyes. Dead: Harawep's Spider twitches on the ground, suffering from is wounds but still gazing upward in raw hatred.

Inquisitorial Deacon.description: Scrutinizing his surroundings with a wary eye, an Inquisitorial deacon is ever vigilant in his task of discovering Necromancers and their supporters, and bringing them to justice. He proudly wears a tabard with an Inquisitorial emblem on the breast, as a warning to any vile heathens that may cross his path.

Ilva.description: You see Shrike Ilva, an Elothean. Ilva has an angular face, crimson-flecked ebon eyes, and a pointy nose. Her auburn hair is long and straight, and is worn parted on the side. She has smooth skin and a spindly figure. She appears to be middle-aged. She is holding a thin onyx-hued blade with smoky edges in her right hand. She is wearing a wide-sleeved robe of somber red dergatine, a dark pewter shrike pendant, some seordstone prayer beads, a black-lacquered rapier sheath, and a pair of pale willow sandals with thornweave straps.

Greater water sprite.description: Introduced in Tuesday Tidings 66. Premie Only

Hurricane drake.description: Small but thick scaled plates cover the drake from head to claws while thicker, angular plates descend along the creature's back. His tail swishes from side to side, leaving flickering sparks of electricity in its wake. With a mouth full of razor-sharp teeth and quill-like barbs protruding menacingly from the tip of his tail, the drake is built for survival -- either by overpowering his foes or enduring and outlasting their attacks.

Juvenile desert armadillo (2).description: Thick, articulated hide plating covers the desert armadillo from its dripping, twitchy snout to its barbed tail. Perfectly adapted to blend into a desert environment, the animal's coloration is a mottled patchwork of sand and tan. With powerful claws for digging protective burrows, a barbed tail, and flexible plating that allows the creature to roll itself up tightly, the armadillo appears well built to defend itself.

Hardened silverfish.description: Silverfish are table-sized creatures encased in a hard, silvery exoskeleton. Three tail-like appendages at the end of their abdomen look strong enough to shatter bone and their front legs sport a razor sharp edge. Mandible clattering incessantly, these are hive creatures and their primal instinct is to bring food to the nest. Any food.

Ichorous ossein amalgam.description: The amalgam appears as a low, irregular mass of eerily transparent green-black ooze threaded with crystallized bone shards. Fractured ribs, splintered joints, animal skulls, and a myriad of other skeletal fragments are suspended just below its surface, forming uneven plates that jut and overlap without symmetry. Viscous material slowly fills gaps between the ossified growths, giving the creature a wet, compressed density, as though its shape is held together by constant internal pressure rather than structure. With no face or identifying features, the only way to tell if it is alive or dead is movement, or lack of.

Haizen drake.description: Small but thick scaled plates cover the drake from head to claws while thicker, angular plates descend along the creature's back. His tail swishes from side to side, leaving flickering sparks of electricity in its wake. With a mouth full of razor-sharp teeth and quill-like barbs protruding menacingly from the tip of his tail, the drake is built for survival -- either by overpowering his foes or enduring and outlasting their attacks.

Inkbound leonine guardian.description: The inkbound leonine guardian is constructed from various pieces of library debris with a powerful, sleek, body with muscular contours. Intense, intelligent, predatory eyes emit a steady amber glow from within a broad face. Long strips of shredded linen drape from its neck and shoulders in a ragged mane, while lacquered parchment furs form the rest of its hide in dense, flexible layers. Its broad paws end in curved claws fashioned from discarded scraps of metal that are polished to a dark gleam. The lean body is reinforced with structural supports and tightly braced framing that depicts a low, powerful stance rather than heavy bulk. Across the length of its form, shadow-black text drifts continuously in wavering currents that slide over parchment and vellum without ever resolving into readable script.

Inkbound lupine guardian.description: The inkbound lupine guardian's wolfish body is wrought of layered structural pieces formed from fractured shelving, warped covers, and tightly compressed stacks of parchment fitted together in narrow, deliberate layers. Strips of stiff vellum overlap across its frame in dense ridges that mimic coarse fur. A steady amber glow burns in the intensely staring eyes, and the gleam of metal beneath its upper lip reveals slightly curved incisors formed from broken penknives. Across the length of its body, shadowed lines of shifting text slide continuously in blurred currents that never resolve into readable script.

Inkbound strigine guardian.description: The inkbound strigine guardian is formed from hardbound covers, book spines, and lacquered scroll caps, all held together with precise, deliberate construction. Over this framework lies a dense covering of parchment-like feathers, arranged in overlapping tiers that mimic plumage. Its beak is sharply hooked, designed with brutal efficiency. Where claws would be, it bears elongated, bladed talons reminiscent of bookbinder's tools. Broad wings extend from its frame as mantled structures rather than instruments of flight, composed of stiff layered song sheets and structural supports. Across its surface, faint shifting patterns of text ripple constantly, an illusion of flowing script that never resolves into readable form. Its eyes glow with a steady amber light, set deep within a gold-embossed head.

Meadow ram.description: Though nearly five feet tall, and equipped with a deadly set of curved horns, the ram seems more interested in chomping on grass than running down visitors to its home.

Kelpie.MapList: *{{rmap|41 | North Road betwen Lang and Theren (41)}}
Kelpie.description: Standing on two legs, the kelpie is somewhat small, like a Dwarf. It looks around, a bit agitated.

Lesser skeleton.description: Standing on two legs the lesser skeleton is humanoid size. It is obviously aggressive and looking for a fight.

Kobold.description: Short and graced with leathery brown skin and a doglike face, the kobold is a runt compared to its cousin the Faenrae Reaver, being about the size and build of a small, bug-ugly Human child. Dressed in whatever piece-mail armor it can find, the kobold fights with the vain pride of a peacock over "its" territory. If not kobold-versus-trespasser, then kobold-versus-kobold. However, in the former case, the kobold is more than willing to communicate with its brethern in a series of whimpers and yips that constitute its language.

Lun'Shele trekhalo.description: You see a lithe, slender creature looking like a cross between a degenerate elf and a desperate halfling, large-eyed, large-eared, and dirty. The smears of mud that form most of its apparel may be ritual markings or perhaps vermin control, but the colors and patterns help to hide it as it hunts. A cape of bedraggled feathers marks the trekhalo as a chieftain among the Lun'Shele. With several strings of teeth around its neck, the trekhalo carries its staffsling with casual confidence and exudes an air of power from its lean, muscular body. Extra Dangers: Ambushes with it's war club while in hiding. Notes: Appears to cast self only spells. Rarely attacks from hiding. Primarily spawns in the same area as Lun'Shele Hunters and Caracals, but can roam into bristle-backed peccary area. Both types of Lun'Shele will attack Caracals and Bristle-backed Peccaries if left alone. These are far more dangerous than the Lun'Shele Hunters. The description of the Trekhalo is deceiving, as it never carries a staffsling. Instead, it always carries a war club, with which it is quite adept at using.

Lun'Shele hunter.description: You see a lithe, slender creature looking like a cross between a degenerate elf and a desperate halfling, large-eyed, large-eared, and dirty. The smears of mud that form most of its apparel may be ritual markings or perhaps vermin control, but the colors and patterns help to hide it as it hunts. A cape of bedraggled feathers marks the hunter as a chieftain among the Lun'Shele. With several strings of teeth around its neck, the hunter carries its staffsling with casual confidence and exudes an air of power from its lean, muscular body.

Lesser sluagh (1).description: The lesser sluagh is a foul-smelling, foul-tempered, foul-looking beast that makes a mother-in-law seem positively angelic. Seven feet tall, musclebound, and wearing some kind of ragged, odiferous hide over its own none too lovely grey skin, it stares with bloodshot eyes and an evil leer. It is a living creature rather than an undead one, though you can't imagine it being any uglier or meaner were it undead. Kind of makes you wonder about the greater ones, doesn't it?

Malodorous bucca.description: Appearing to be the curious cross-breed of a goblin and a kobold, the malodorous bucca hops about with an untamed maniacal glint in its eyes. About three feet tall and slight of build, the malodorous buccas are most noted for their yellow teeth, foul disposition and above all their horrendous stench. A wild mane of black air drapes its body like a thick coat, partially wrapped in the tattered remains of clothing that dangle from its shoulders and waist. The malodorous bucca is well known for its trickery in the mines they tend to call home, causing sometime tragic accidents when their desire to cause mayhem and chaos get the better of them.

Kra'hei hatchling.description: The hatchling looks like a S'Kra Mur mother's nightmare. Young and lithe, its features and limbs are warped and twisted. Its single-minded and innocent viciousness is disturbingly belied by a flickering light of intelligence in its reptilian eyes.

Kra'hei.description: The kra'hei looks much like a S'kra but its features are warped. Its limbs are deformed though still powerful. The kra'hei has a wild look in its eyes and foam at its mouth. If it was ever a civilized creature there is no longer any signs of that sanity.

Lithe blight ogre.description: The blight ogre looks like it might be female, but since you're not an ogre it's hard to tell. She's smaller than her warmer-climate cousins and moves with a grace that belies her muscled frame. Her large red eyes scan the area alertly.

Maelshyvean cinder beast.description: Part of a collective legion that functions as the sword-arm of corrupt demigoddess Maelshyve, the cinder beast is a hulking beast in the vague form of a man with unnaturally frightening musculature and covered in glistening metallic-red scales. Stout ebon spines run down its neck, back, and arms. Sizable tusks jut from beneath its fearsome maw. It towers a few feet above even the tallest Gor'Tog, dwarfing you further with a pair of talon-tipped black wings that spire skyward from behind its back. Gruesome ebon claws adorn its thick arms and legs, each tined with three individual spikes. A radiant green glow burns furiously within its deep-set eyesockets, illuminating its slavering blood-drenched maw.

Maelshyvean shadow beast.description: An elite soldier in Maelshyve's army, the shadow beast is no more the height of an Olvi, yet by virtue of sheer musculature is as powerful as any Gor'Tog. Its body is nearly completely covered in a swirling mass of pure darkness, and its broad head and oversized pointed ears combine with lips and fangs bent into a permanent horrifying smile to give the shadow beast a cruel demeanor.

Marbled angiswaerd.description: Normal: A drearily colored combination of greys and mottled brown scales cover the marbled angiswaerd from its massive jaws to its tapering tail. Tufts of reddish hair protrude from the back of its head and from under the chin, giving it an elderly look, but there is nothing else to imply that this thing is anything less than young, powerful and very fast. After consumption: A drearily colored combination of greys and mottled brown scales cover the marbled angiswaerd from its massive jaws to its tapering tail. Tufts of reddish hair protrude from the back of its head and from under the chin, giving it an elderly look, but there is nothing else to imply that this thing is anything less than young, powerful and very fast. Its sides bulge, as if it had recently swallowed something. After death: Though clearly serpentine, there's not enough left to understand exactly what it was. NOTE: You can not LOOK to see wounds or what it carries. This is not a bug.

Long-fanged warcat.description: A long-fanged warcat is covered in pale tawny fur, dappled with brown. Its shoulders rise almost a hand-span above your head, surmounted by a broad flat face and a fluffy tail. Its wide mouth is closed, but long fangs are visible extending about a thumb's length below its lip.

Lanky grey lach.description: The grey lach is a tall, lanky beast that would look almost human if not for the sickly, dull grey skin stretching over its twisted and knobby bones. There is a definite methodical grace about the creature's movements, sinuously reptilian in nature despite its hideously wretched and awkward appearance. Abyssal eyes, as blank and dark as the starless midnight skies, are sunken deeply within its expressionless face, as if the creature somehow stands before you in body but not soul.

Lesser dusky-scaled basilisk.description: The basilisk is a great, fearsome lizard with dusky midnight-blue scales. Four powerful legs ending in brutal hooked claws keep it perched low to the ground, making it fast despite its large size. A thick, muscular tail barbed with sharp stiletto-like spines protrudes behind it, lashing back and forth menacingly. Foreboding coils of smoke rise from its nostrils, snaking off into the air.

Maiden's tress.description: A writhing maiden's tress appears to be a curtain of interwoven thorny vines that looks a great deal like a mass of writhing serpents.

Lesser shadow hound.description: ===Alive=== Starlike silver eyes twinkle amidst a cloak of shadows so dark that the creature before you seems to be made of the essence of night itself. The lithe beast resembles something canine in nature, although it appears more nimble than strong. Slender sabre-like silver fangs protrude from its maw, and tendrils of inky black mist exude from its nostrils as it breathes.

Maeldryth (creature).description: Composed of a mass of churning shadows, the maeldryth's amorphous form is clearly of foreign origin to this plane. Dozens of tentacles snake outward from the nexus of inky blackness, sweeping aimlessly through the air in languid, almost lethargic strokes.

Lesser North Wind banshee.description: The North Wind banshee is a spectral being, female in form. Her hands form sharp claws cabable of rending all matter, her own insubstantial being torn and wounded by her desperate self-mutilation. She moans and cries, her hair a dissheveled mop, her garments tattered to pathetic rags.

Large brown spider.description: Supported on multiple legs, the brown spider is humanoid size. It is obviously aggressive and looking for a fight.

Large musk hog.description: The musk hog has a scruffy, squat body that is brownish-gray. An unpleasant odor hovers around the beast. You can make out tiny bugs (maybe fleas?) hopping around on its dirty coat. Its broad, flat snout is constantly twitching.

Seven feet tall, musclebound, and wearing some kind of ragged, odiferous hide over its own none too lovely grey skin, it stares with bloodshot eyes and an evil leer. It is a living creature rather than an undead one, though you can't imagine it being any uglier or meaner were it undead. Kind of makes you wonder about the greater ones, doesn't it?

It is a living creature rather than an undead one, though you can't imagine it being any uglier or meaner were it undead. Kind of makes you wonder about the greater ones, doesn't it?

Leathery grey ghoul.description: The ghoul looks like some sick parody of mankind perpetrated by a mad god. Standing over six feet tall, its mud-caked skin is pale grey splotched with green. Its torso and limbs are elongated and bone thin. A pair of evil red eyes stare out at you from within its distorted hairless skull, above a grinning mouth lined with rows of jagged teeth.

Mange-covered rotting Rakash.description: Mangy skin covers the rotting race is::Rakash, tightly stretched over bone and rotting sinew. Despite the fact that its features are badly distended and bloated, the lupine nature of its former race in moonskin is evident. A stench of decay rises from the Rakash, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice. Parry soft caps at 100. Multi soft caps at 102-103.

Mange-covered rotting Prydaen.description: Mangy skin covers the rotting race is::Prydaen, tightly stretched over bone and rotting sinew. Despite the fact that its features are badly distended and bloated, the feline nature of its former race is evident. A stench of decay rises from the Prydaen, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice.

Kirm lybas.description: The kirm lybas appears to be a figure engulfed in a rich sable cassock which obscures its features. Only when it lowers its cowl can its pasty, pale face be seen. Its sunken eyes glow with an unhealthy fervor, and its cracked lips are speckled with blood. Yet somehow, light seems to pass through it, giving away its spectral nature.

Lachmate.description: Resembling nothing more than an ambulatory rubbish heap, the large lachmate is covered in leaves and other trash. Small extensions of the ooze within form feelers that allow it to grab at its surroundings.

Kather warrior.description: Though vaguely human in form, the has evolved from years underground to need very little light. Two eerily white eyes peer out from a slit in his leather armor which covers him down to his closed-toe sandals. A pale, bony hand is visible grasping his heavily decorated greatsword with strength unthinkable for such a frail-looking creature.

Kather watcher.description: Though vaguely human in form, the Kather watcher has evolved from years underground to need very little light. Two eerily white eyes peer out from a slit in her tight leather armor which covers her down to her closed-toe sandals. A pale, bony hand holds a pitch-black crossbow at her waist, directly next to a heavily decorated sheath containing her blades.

Lava drake.description: The lava drake is a creature of raw incandescence drawn straight from the molten heart of Elanthia. Resembling a small angiswaerd, the construct is the length of a full-grown Gor'Tog and is protected by a multitude volcanic rock scales that cover its molten body from snout to tail. The creature is constantly changing and reforming, its form as fluid as its substance, but it tends to have a sinuous, low-slung body supported by four sturdy legs. Its fiery maw is crowded with razor-sharp teeth, and its eyes are pits of white-hot fire. Shrouded in a mantle of shifting flames, the lava drake leaves smoldering footprints wherever it goes.

Mage's construct.description: Composed of the gods only know what, the construct was created by the hand of a powerful mage. Made for the sole purpose of standing guard, it will do its best to keep invaders from penetrating deeper into the depths of its creator's domain.

Mapha arzumos.description: The mapha arzumos is an astonishingly large cat creature, its massive head glinting with intelligent eyes. Its fur is greyish-white with black stripes, with a white underbelly and very pale stripes on its forehead. Within the grasses, the stripes disrupt the body outline, and as it crouches motionless it blurs to near invisibility.

Maelshyvean vessel.description: The Maelshyvean vessel is an emerald-eyed Human woman seemingly in the middle of some vile transformation. Suppurating patches of purple-speckled blue scales cover her face and clawed limbs in patterns that encroach inward. Her wavy brown hair has been shorn unevenly, giving way to other growths on her head.

Lesser voltaic custodian.description: Walking on jagged stilts of electricity, the voltaic custodian is an intricately constructed orichalcum coil suspended inside a beryl-hued ball lightning. What pass for limbs appear to be fluidly defined: transient arcs continuously sprout or blow away.

Lightning selrek.description: The lightning selrek is a crackling mass of solidified power, bound in the shape of an androgynous, skeletally thin Elf. It has lurid carmine eyes and no other distinguishable features.

Magma cobra.description: ==Recall== Once little more than myth, recent excavations into the Pivilho Volcano revealed these creations beneath the heat and pressure-tortured stone. Said to be shaped by Hav'roth and imbued with the fury of Ushnish, the magma cobras are ferocious protectors of their domain, moving through solid and molten rock with equal ease. Their scales and hoods bear mesmerizing patterns that resemble those found in ancient S'Kra Mur architecture and decoration. Their very presence tortures the air and earth, and their highly adaptive nature makes them dangerous for the careless adventurer. Many have been caught unaware by the magma cobra's quick response to an onslaught and only too late realized the importance of a varied assault. Little is known of their life cycles or desires, but the magma cobra have only been observed within the Pivilho volcano. Whether they are meant to guard something deeper or simply thriving in their niche environment remains unknown, but what is clear is that these creatures posses none of Peri'el's gentle disposition. The magma cobras are known to cast the casts spell::Mark of Arhat and casts spell::Fire of Ushnish spells. You recall covering yourself in the crushed crystal debris, affording you some protection from their fire aura. It will fade in approximately 4 roisaen. You feel slightly protected. You recall covering yourself in the crushed crystal debris, affording you some protection from their earth aura. It will fade in approximately 4 roisaen. You feel slightly protected.

Lengthy grass eel.description: No more than eighteen inches long, this grass eel has a nasty disposition entirely out of proportion with its size. In fact it looks more like a green bootlace than anything else. The eel more than makes up in speed and agility what it lacks in strength, however, and a score of bites from a score of grass eels would not be a pleasant experience.

Meandering mountain marauder.description: Nomadic life in the rugged northern steppes has given the mountain marauder leathery skin, sun-bleached hair, and a near constant squint against the harsh brilliance of the open sky. She wears robes of richly dyed fabric that drape and snap in the ceaseless breeze of her mountain home.

Musk hog.description: The musk hog has a scruffy, squat body that is brownish-gray. An unpleasant odor hovers around the beast. You can make out tiny bugs (maybe fleas?) hopping around on its dirty coat. Its broad, flat snout is constantly twitching.

Morah creeper.description: From a species of flesh-eating plant known to inhabit some of Elanthia's less-explored forests, the morah creeper resembles a thorn vine, with its tapering body and razor-like leaves which cover it like plate armor. The reddish tip of each leaf should have indicated to you that this was a dangerous plant, but now that you are close enough to look at it, may the gods preserve you in your attempt to get away with your life.

Nightweaver unyn.description: The nightweaver unyn is larger than a Tog, without adding in the legs. Wiry black hairs cover its entire body, except for the silver-grey around its eyes. Thick fangs protrude from its mouth, seemingly blacker than its body, if that's possible. It is highly aggressive, and always hungry.

Moss mey.description: The mey smiles tauntingly, as her pale luminosity shimmers in the misty light. Her tangled hair and slender figure have a bit of the greenish-grey hue of the trees and mist, and she herself does not appear completely real and solid.

Mountain giant.description: The giant is as tall as the mountains it was named for, with legs the size of large trees and arms resembling slightly smaller ones. A thick layer of rock-strewn moss dangles from its shoulders and back, held securely by the root structure of the numerous juvenile saplings winding around its stone grey flesh. Thick verdant hair, littered with shards of bone and discarded food, falls in coarse layers from its head and narrow jaw, frame the sunken features of its craggy visage. Sunken red eyes, though showing little intelligence, reveal unrestrained hostility towards anything that may be considered food, no matter the size!

Nightreaver unyn.description: The nightreaver unyn is larger than a Tog, without adding in the legs. Wiry black hairs cover its entire body, except for the silver-grey around its eyes. Thick fangs protrude from its mouth, seemingly blacker than its body, if that's possible. It is highly aggressive, and always hungry. The nightreaver variety is somewhat plumper and more violent than its nightweaving relatives.

Merrows.description: Lithe and powerful, the (dark/azure/crimson) merrows is a vaguely humanoid merfolk. Bulging yellow eyes glare threateningly from the merrows' hideous pug-face and needle-like teeth gnash with a constant hunger for warm flesh. The merrows' tail is thick and strong enough to propel it swiftly through the swirling waters of the caverns, leaving its gangly arms free to shred prey with their razor-sharp claws.

Nightstalker unyn.description: Located outside the east gate of Riverhaven in the Pejek Bog. They are in a 'Estate Holder's Only' area.

Nipoh oshu (1).description: Swirling whisps of steam hang together in an amorphous cloud of vapor, with crude limbs protruding from its mass, waving as if held in in a breeze. Two malevolent eyes glare hatefully from deep within its body.

Muscular firecat.description: The muscular firecat is a large cat of sleek build with powerful leaping muscles that ripple beneath its thick black coat. Flames flicker above its tufted ears, and its eyes shift from red to gold to blue as it watches, waiting for the perfect opportunity to pounce.

Misshapen germish'din.description: Held together by a patchwork layer of leathery skin, the misshapen germish'din is a mass of powerful muscle bound by rows of heavy stitching. A menagerie of twisted limbs rise from the beast's body at disturbingly obtuse angles, but there is little that would convey any awkwardness to its attack. Perhaps the most prominent feature of the germish'din is not its misshapen form, but its pair of large, blackened eyes, sewn tightly shut with thick cord.

Mottled westanuryn.description: Barely two feet long and made of dense chiton and sinew, the westanuryn resembles an oversized, nightmarish scorpion, right down to the vicious looking stinger held aloft in perpetual readiness. Lined along its front claws are jagged armor plates, most likely used to burrow through sand and dirt at speed, and provide additional protection from struggling prey to the front.

Misenseor resuscitant.description: Human only in size and form, this wretched creature is clearly powered by some supernatural energy. It is constantly in motion of some kind, sharply wrenching its decaying head from side to side or twitching its dead limbs erratically. Its body is covered with shredded remnants of clothing, but its skin underneath is corded with dessicated muscles that strain with its every movement.
