Mutilated transmogrified oaf.description: The ghoul looks like some sick parody of mankind perpetrated by a mad god. Standing over six feet tall, its mud-caked skin is pale grey splotched with green. Its torso and limbs are elongated and bone thin. A pair of evil red eyes stare out at you from within its distorted hairless skull, above a grinning mouth lined with rows of jagged teeth.

Mummer.description: This bizarre creature appears to be formed of reflective metal. Its features appear vague and slippery, yet as you look close you can see the surroundings reflected a thousandfold times within the mirrored surface.

Nimble cadaverous assassin.description: The festering morass of mortality before you is clearly of the kobold race, looking like a strange cross between human and common alley mutt. Rotting flesh hangs loosely from its disturbingly visible bones, making it clear that this beast hasn't been truly alive in quite some time. Its bulky form appears strong for a kobold, and capable of steady, devastating blows.

Muscular ghoulish slayer.description: The ghoul looks like some sick parody of mankind perpetrated by a mad god. Standing over six feet tall, its mud-caked skin is pale grey splotched with green. Its torso and limbs are elongated and bone thin. A pair of evil red eyes stare out at you from within its distorted hairless skull, above a grinning mouth lined with rows of jagged teeth.

Naga.description: A naga summoned by Beckon the Naga: While it largely resembles an enormous cobra with its sinuous body and patterned hood, the pandemonium of sound and color that surround it designates this creature as something wholly different. Underneath the confusing aura is a scaled hide that fades in and out of sight, though it appears solid enough. The naga drifts aloft with eerie, explosive darting motions, oddly distorting the air in its wake. * Beckon the Naga

Miserly Moneygrubber.description: This beast of a man has clearly tasted the pleasures of the good life, as evidenced by his fine attire and bloated stomach. Perhaps a former trader or wandering merchant, his overwhelming greed has completely consumed him, only to leave him in a state of insatiable lust for material wealth. His eyes grow as large as the coins in his pouch as he appraises you from head to toe. You can almost hear him counting the cash as he sells off your possessions to the imaginary pawn shop in his deluded mind.

Mutant togball.description: Hunchbacked into a sickly "C" shape, the stunted creature's spine curves like the handle of a giant coffee mug. The deformed humanoid's leathery brown skin exhibits dozens of old scars from use on the playing field as merely a tool, an object at the disposal of much stronger and violent beings. Neither its bulging eyes or mangled facial features provide information about which sentient race it belonged to prior to its damnation. Vertebrae, grossly misshapen and misaligned, protrude from the figure's back, forever warped into place by cruel and unforgiving hands. Plastered with a crazed expression of morbid fear mixed with insatiable bloodlust, the togball foams at the mouth in anticipation of gaining revenge on those responsible for its current state, no matter how hopeless an endeavor that may be.

Neimhur.description: You see Priestess Neimhur, a Faenrae. Neimhur has glowing green eyes. Her blue-black hair is long and thick, and is worn arranged in tight dreadlocks. She has withered grey skin. She is very tall for a Faenrae. She is in good shape. She is holding a short bow in her right hand. She is wearing a pewter circlet inset with chipped red-green bloodstones, a silver kyanite gwethdesuan, a triple nose ring of tarnished copper, a crystal-beaded quiver, a faded blue satin robe embroidered with many-forked lightning bolts, an ordinary shield and a felted Human-hair pouch.

Nimbus.description: Surrounded by twitching tendrils of wispy light the nimbus could be mistaken for a particularly ill-tempted will-o'-the-wisp. Closer inspection reveals a pale imp-like body, with four clawed arms twisted with excessive joints. Softly glowing swirls of color drift aimlessly along its skin as it silently hovers slightly off the ground. The plural of nimbus is nimbi or nimbuses.

Mor blarstil.description: Formed from putrid earth into this huge beast, the Mor Blarstil is not a thing to be played with. No emotion or expression crosses its vaguely humanoid features and it utters no sound, but the power within its monstrous limbs speak well enough on their own.

Narmorbreth.description: Covered in blue and grey scales instead of skin, the bulbous-eyed narmorbreth unblinkingly stares at anyone who gazes upon him. The distinctive shine of slime and water coats his fish-like body with a healthy moisture, though his bloated belly implies that of a sickly perch. Still, his face belies an intellect that would not be out of place in Merelew society.

Misty black zephyr.description: Tendrils of dark mist swirl around the black zephyr, guided by a constant frigid wind that roars in a circular pattern around its body. Through the baneful cloud, an almost-corporeal skeletal form is visible, complete with a pair of massive tusk-like incisors that jut in a primitive, animalistic manner down from its twisted maw. It stands roughly the size of a Gor'Tog.

Morah vine.description: From a species of flesh-eating plant known to inhabit some of Elanthia's less-explored forests, the morah vine resembles a thorn vine, with its tapering body and razor-like leaves which cover it like plate armor. The reddish tip of each leaf should have indicated to you that this was a dangerous plant, but now that you are close enough to look at it, may the gods preserve you in your attempt to get away with your life.

Medium crevice worm.description: The crevice worm looks like a big tube made of rock, dust, and precious metal. Oozing between the cracks in its hard rock shell is the acid that holds the rocks on and helps it move freely through the underground passageways. Having no real head, it leads and bashes prey with one end of its symmetrical body and uses the other as a feeler to sense its next meal through vibrations in the rock. * Small Crevice Worm

Mimic.description: This amorphous being appears humanoid in shape but little else can be seen of its features. With further scrutiny however, a slight flicker can be seen as if many faces and forms suddenly course across its body.

Murder crow.description: Alive: Huge even for its species, the bird has groomed coal-black feathers that cover its body, and already looks well fattened from the bountiful harvest. Its large beak appears ideal for cracking open hard objects and its sharp talons look ready to tear apart corn and flesh alike. Dead: The murder crow is little more than a pile of tangled feathers now.

Nacre-plated Torbisan decapod.description: Standing taller than a Gor'Tog, the Torbisan decapod is the embodiment of an abyssal nightmare. Twin pairs of eyestalks constantly twitch around, scanning in all directions, and brilliantly iridescent bands zigzag down the creature's nacreous torso. The decapod bears two enormous clublike arms in a folded position, and a series of churning mouthparts are ready to cut, shred, and tear any defeated prey.

Moss spirit.description: The moss spirit is unusual and not quite like anything you have ever set eyes on. You're not sure just what to make of it.

Miniscule animated items.description: Animated items come in many shapes and sizes. This one is a miniscule item. Where item can be one of the following: * bowl * cup * fork * griddle * knife * lid * pan * plate * pot * spoon * teapot

Moltspun boggle.description: Small and spindly, the moltspun boggle is a member of the Fae, its body composed seemingly of bits of animal discard. Tufts of fur, transparent scales, some teeth, and a couple shed antler pieces compose this bizarre humanoid-shaped entity. The moltspun boggle is continually on the lookout for more material to add to its body and has been observed sneaking up to woodland creatures of any size and grabbing fistfuls of fur before beating a hasty retreat. To their credit, they are quite nimble -- the only real defense they have against the consequences of their mischief.

Pale grey death squirrel (creature).MapList: *{{rmap|7b | Road from Arthe Dale to Arthe Bay (7b)}}
Pale grey death squirrel (creature).description: The death squirrel is a horribly twisted and deformed cousin of your average grey squirrel, likely animated beyond death by an amateur necromancer. Knobby bones protrude through paper-thin skin, patched with intermittent tufts of scraggly pale grey fur. Two beady little red eyes pierce outward over a rabidly foaming maw equipped with several hooked fangs.

Pale grey death spirit.MapList3: *{{rmap|30b | Dunshade Manor (30b)}}*{{rmap|60 | Forest of Night (60)}}*{{rmap|92 | Undead on Ratha (92)}}
Pale grey death spirit.description: The grey death spirit is a mass of swirling shadow given substance. Clothed in little but the rag of a robe, its hands are terribly jagged claws, its eyes a glowing sanguine color. The creature appears to have the mentality of the damned, moving with intention and deadly grace as it floats about.

Peccary.description: At first glance, you think boar but when you see the peccary in full you realize this is a different animal entirely. However like the common boar the tiny eyes and massive snout are caged behind two mean-looking curved tusks. Its startlingly white lips contrast sharply with its dark grey almost black hide.

Orc raider.description: Small, thankfully unidentifiable black creatures crawl around in the orc raider's greasy grey hair. With fastidious personal habits of a peccary in a mud-pit, the raider stops from time to time to pick one of the insects off his scalp and pop it into his mouth, smacking his lips greedily as he chews. Standing no more than a hand's width higher than the average human, the raider's musculature is considerably more dense, with thick bones and an almost ape-like curve to its skull. A red bear paw has been tattooed on his shoulder, identifying him as a member of the member of::red bear clan of race is::orcs.

Pirate (1).description: The pirate looks as if it has been at sea way too long and is someone you probably wouldn't like to meet in a dark alley. The red sash it is wearing quickly warns you that this is one of the infamous Red Sash pirates of the Reshal Sea, one of the most bloodthirsty ocean clans known on Elanthia.

Ochre la'heke.description: The length of an average Human, the la'heke resembles a fish with four wiry legs with sucker gripping toes known as ashu'a. Trailing behind its scaled body is a flat tail, complete with a triangular tail fin. A protruding lower jaw houses threateningly sharp, fanglike teeth.

Olensari mihmanan.description: Formed entirely of bleached bones, the olensari mihmanan is obviously no natural beast. Its joints seem oddly fused, as though the creature was carved rather than assembled. One clawed arm hangs loosely by its side while the other juts up and back, set much like the business end of a stout catapult. A jagged fragment of broken bone rests in this skyward hand, ready to be propelled forward in the blinking of an eye.

It looks surprisingly hostile, and its drawn-on eyes peer forward with what may be a superimposed intelligence. Although made from paper, the origami looks like it's been hardened by the magic, making it much stronger and more durable than if it were simple paper.

Piranha.description: All jaw and sleek body, a huge russet brown piranha swims through the water with an ease that can only be admired. Unfortunately, that same sleek form allows the piranha to get close to its prey where its razor-sharp teeth can rend flesh from bone. In a group, they can be deadly within moments.

It lives primarily on the savannah grasses, grazing for tender new blades just poking through the ground, which it digs with its smaller, but sharply clawed forelegs. Its leathery skin is dark as the ebon grass and swirls in patterns like tender new scales. Most unusual is its abdominal pouch which carries the newly hatched egglings not strong enough to move safely with its herd.

Onyx gargoyle.description: Composed of rock, the gargoyle is a statue come to life at the hand of an ambitious mage. Mostly irate at the world and grumbling to itself about anything from the state of the Elven nation to the weather, the gargoyle does not look so much inclined to fight as it is to curl up in a corner and look frightening. Still, it knows its task as a protector of its creator's domain, and will do its best to keep invaders from treading on its turf.

Overgrown plant.description: An overgrown plant curls itself into a tight coil, making itself resembling a bouquet of brilliantly colored flowers. A mad tangle of vines, strikingly beautiful flowers, nodules of green growth, and other twisted vegetation, the bulk of the overgrown plant moves distressingly rapidly as it seeks out warm flesh. Its roots trail behind it, absorbing nothing but constantly seeking water and other nutrients.

Revenant zombie.description: Gaunt skin covers the revenant zombie, tightly stretched over bone and rotting sinew. It is obviously humanoid, but so badly distended and bloated are its features that precisely what race is a mystery. A stench of decay rises from the zombie, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice.

River caiman.description: About as long as a Halfling is tall, this river caiman is a dull olive-green, with faded black spots and a slightly yellowish color along its underbelly. The common name derives from the bony ridge along the front of the eyes, lending it the appearance of wearing spectacles. It's common to spot these creatures from the decks of ships and barges along the Faldesu as they bask in the sun or float lazily in the water. They're usually not aggressive, but have been known to get particularly ravenous when food supplies are low -- unfortunately, this specimen seems to fall in this latter category.

Piruati serpent.description: This is a rather large snake, which looks ready to supplement its diet with a large serving of YOU!

Retan dolomar.description: The retan dolomar is a squat, many-legged beast with a hard carapace. Rivaling a yak in mass, the dolomar has been known to kill and eat almost anything it could sink its pincers into. Desert legend suggests that it is this very beast that destroyed the entire population of the West Palms Oasis and halted trade to the northern and western quarters of the desert all together.

River boa.description: One could easily mistake the river boa for a fallen log until you note the cold malignant stare of its eyes. Silent and deadly it lies in wait for an unsuspecting victim to pass buy. Then with an explosive burst of speed it strikes, quickly stunning its prey and then crushing it within a deadly embrace. Once enmeshed within the coils of this powerful creature your only hope lies in the good will of others.

Poloh'izh.description: The poloh'izh is a land lizard with a tough skin of small and slightly iridescent scales. Faint variations of grassland colors ripple across its hide continually, making it somewhat difficult to focus upon. It lashes its narrow tail back and forth with a whip-like snap.

Ring-necked gidii.description: One of the many flightless birds which inhabit this particular area, the gidii is typically smelly, unkempt, awkward and ugly. This one is definitely typical.

Rhoat moda.description: The rhoat moda is bulbous and lumpy in peculiar places under its rubbery greenish hide where massive muscles for jumping and leverage flex and relax at curious intervals. Its mouth is wide with a sinister upward curl that never quite reaches the unblinking eyes.

Rat.City: Crossing, Riverhaven, Shard, Fang Cove, Ratha
Rat.description: Standing on four legs, the rat is small. It clearly views everything as an enemy.

Retch fiend.description: An abomination to the gods, the retch fiend stares at you with lidless, bulging eyes that glow with a putrid jade tint. The sickly green tinge extends to its lifeless face twisted by the permanent snarl of its lipless maw. A fetid stench emanates from the waterfall of noxious black slime that oozes from beneath its decayed flesh and collects in a glistening pool at its feet. A mass of maggots, worms and various other insects squirm within the slime and the beast's throat, writhing about either to slide beneath its rotten skin with an audible slurp, or burrow into the fiend's shriveled frame.

Revenant conscript.description: The revenant conscript is a remnant of some long-annihilated army, still clinging to the Plane of Abiding through spiritual tenacity alone.

Red-bristled gremlin.description: The gremlin stands waist-high to a Human, though its perpetually hunched figure indicates it could possibly look one in the eye if it bothered to stand up straight. Black leathery reptilian skin covers its entire body, reflecting little light. Spindly legs would appear to be too thin to support its wide-shouldered frame, but its easy, predatory grace belies any implied clumsiness. A wide, triangular head with large pointed ears sits atop a short narrow neck, and it glares about with squinting yellow eyes.

Red-Gold scaled atik'et (1).description: The scaled atik'et resembles a slightly built S'Kra Mur woman with red-gold scales and a fiery crest atop her head. Flickering flames dance back and forth from finger to finger, and her lips are parted in a soft, hissing croon.

Red-Gold scaled atik'et (2).description: The scaled atik'et resembles a slightly built S'Kra Mur woman with golden scales and a fiery crest atop her head. Flickering flames dance back and forth from finger to finger, and her lips are parted in a soft, hissing croon.

Preserved zombified Rakash.description: Mangy skin covers the zombified race is::Rakash, tightly stretched over bone and rotting sinew. Despite the fact that its features are badly distended and bloated, the lupine nature of its former race in moonskin is evident. A stench of decay rises from the Rakash, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice.

Putrefying shambler.description: The ghoul looks like some sick parody of mankind perpetrated by a mad god. Standing over six feet tall, its mud-caked skin is pale grey splotched with green. Its torso and limbs are elongated and bone thin. A pair of evil red eyes stare out at you from within its distorted hairless skull, above a grinning mouth lined with rows of jagged teeth.

Pugnacious pinchfist.description: This beast of a man has clearly tasted the pleasures of the good life, as evidenced by his fine attire and bloated stomach. Perhaps a former trader or wandering merchant, his overwhelming greed has completely consumed him, only to leave him in a state of insatiable lust for material wealth. His eyes grow as large as the coins in his pouch as he appraises you from head to toe. You can almost hear him counting the cash as he sells off your possessions to the imaginary pawn shop in his deluded mind.

Profane destroyer.description: Standing on two legs, the profane destroyer is humanoid size. It is obviously aggressive and looking for a fight.

Red brocket deer.description: A rather small species of deer, the brocket deer is unusual in that it will aggressively defend its territory. Standing about twelve hands high, it is characterized by its oversized ears and a reddish tint to its coat. Its front hooves are quite large in particular, ideal for use in both attacking and swift leaps.

Race shadow.description: The creature looks very in its form, even in the shape of the head. Despite a lack of discernible face or features, the shadow looks extremely hostile.

Plated serpent.description: The plated serpent's body consists of interlocking scales colored invarious tones of earthy grey and brown. Where the head joins the neck is aboney crest from which the beast draws its name. With a girth rivaling a deobar tree, and the long, curving fangs, this is definately not a creature to be discounted in battle.

Poho moglin.description: Lines of harrowing agony stretch the face of this once noble Gor'Tog, replacing its features with twisted paraodies of their former grace. Untold years of frustrating undead existance have tortured it into a viscious,hateful being, massive of frame with bulging muscles honed iron-hard by a lifetime of forced labor. Now this creature seeks only to bring devastation to those that still live. You notice infected looking sores clustered on the rotten flesh surrounding the exposed fingerbones of the surmi orek's hands. Moglin's scales have turned dull and dry, flaking away to expose a pale underskin of mottled grey. Tattered remnants of once fine robes shroud his ancient corpse, partially obscuring this unliving thing.

Pirate sailor.description: The sailor looks as if it has been at sea way too long and is someone you probably wouldn't like to meet in a dark alley. The red sash it is wearing quickly warns you that this is one of the infamous Red Sash pirates of the Reshal Sea, one of the most bloodthirsty ocean clans known on Elanthia.

Quartz gargoyle.description: Composed of rock, the gargoyle is a statue come to life at the hand of an ambitious mage. Mostly irate at the world and grumbling to itself about anything from the state of the Elven nation to the weather, the gargoyle does not look so much inclined to fight as it is to curl up in a corner and look frightening. Still, it knows its task as a protector of its creator's domain, and will do its best to keep invaders from treading on its turf.

Ragged wind hag.description: Draped in priestly vestments, this ancient-looking Gor'Tog woman cuts a frail and emaciated figure. She has mismatched eyes peering out from under her cowl, one cyan and one ebon. On her belt is a glowing silver chain threaded with a multitude of crystal beads that clatter together at every movement.

Redcap enforcer.description: Despite their small size, the redcap enforcer neverthess has a reputation for cruelty and cunning. Although hideously deformed, they look much like large Gnomes at first glance. A closer look reveals razor-sharp teeth, long, curved claws, and an expression of hatred that leaves no doubt that it intends to use both. Like all redcap, it wears a conical cap of red, dyed in the blood of its previous victims.

Raving redcap.description: Despite their small size, the raving redcap neverthess has a reputation for cruelty and cunning. Although hideously deformed, they look much like large Gnomes at first glance. A closer look reveals razor-sharp teeth, long, curved claws, and an expression of hatred that leaves no doubt that it intends to use both. Like all redcap, it wears a conical cap of red, dyed in the blood of its previous victims.

Pirate zombie.description: The pirate zombie is clothed in tattered sailor's garb, clinging to pale bluish-green skin that stretches tightly over bloated and rotting water-logged flesh. Tears and gashes in the creature's stiffened limbs and torso reveal a violent death, and the stench of decay swirls around it, permeating the air.

Rebel novice.description: Cavalier, dashingly-dressed and filled with the wild blood of the gypsy, the novice cuts an impressive figure despite his penchant for murder and mayhem. You see a rebel novice. The rebel novice is in good shape. It is wearing a pink pouch. It is carrying a parang. Also seen with It is wearing a pink ring. It is carrying a spiked club.

Rebel hunter.description: Cavalier, dashingly-dressed and filled with the wild blood of the gypsy, the novice cuts an impressive figure despite his penchant for murder and mayhem. You see a rebel hunter. The rebel hunter is in good shape. It is wearing a pink pouch. It is carrying some smooth rocks, a sling.

Rebel gladiator.description: Cavalier, dashingly-dressed and filled with the wild blood of the gypsy, the gladiator cuts an impressive figure despite his penchant for murder and mayhem. You see a rebel gladiator. The rebel gladiator is in good shape. It is wearing a pink cloak. It is carrying a heavy mallet.

Rebel mercenary.description: Cavalier, dashingly-dressed and filled with the wild blood of the gypsy, the mercenary cuts an impressive figure despite his penchant for murder and mayhem. You see a rebel mercenary. The rebel mercenary is in good shape. It is wearing a pink sash. It is carrying a morning star. Level 110 cleric unable to hit: Taking stock of its offensive abilities, and defending with a triangular sipar stamped with the emblem of Saint Aesetani in gold and a bronze broadsword with a tempered blade, you are certain that the rebel mercenary is a very difficult opponent. (+8) Taking stock of its defensive abilities, and attacking with a bronze broadsword with a tempered blade, you are certain that the rebel mercenary is a difficult opponent. (+5)

Rebel marksman.description: Cavalier, dashingly-dressed and filled with the wild blood of the gypsy, the marksman cuts an impressive figure despite his penchant for murder and mayhem.

Rafflesia.description: At the center of this plant is a flower, which has a jaw-like open mouth at the center of its petals. Liquid pools in this cavity, and appears fairly toxic. Large green vines stretch out from every direction of the central flower, whipping about with surprising speed and constantly seeking out prey. A constant scent of rotting flesh emanates from the foul plant.

Putrid tree snake.description: Quick and lithe, the putrid tree snake is a blur of movement, with only the occasional glimpse of fangs to show why it is a feared opponent in the forest.

S'sugi malchata.description: Alien in appearance, the s'sugi malchata could be mistaken for a humanoid at a great distance. However, up close there's no room for uncertainty. An insect-like head and slitted yellow eyes cap a sinuous three part body. Long, segmented appendages protrude out of the creature's back, hooked around its torso like an extra set of ribs. Short, jagged claws cap its humanoid-hands, and wavering antennae probe the air. Oddly, the s'sugi malchata's multi-jointed legs don't make contact with the ground, it appears to hover above the sand on an invisible cushion.

Scarlet crayfish.description: The scarlet crayfish is unusual and not quite like anything you have ever set eyes on. You're not sure just what to make of it.

Rock troll (1).description: The troll towers menacingly over you, its small, beady black eyes glittering with a dim, cruel intelligence and set into a face that is pock-marked and surmounted by an incredibly long and wart-covered nose. Its skin is a grey slate color, and the nails on its hideous hands are broken and yellowed. Beneath them, you notice bits of flesh and dirt, and the stench of rotting flesh and decay is thick about the brutal creature.

S'lai scout.description: Looking like nothing so much as a ill-bred cross between a bat and some sort of diminutive lizard-man, the S'lai are a vicious breed of nocturnal cave-dwellers. The Scout's furry, reptilian head sits atop a dark, scaly torso which in turn is covered with a slight coat of dark hair. Two stubby legs, lizard-like in appearance, end in a pair of wide feet, each equipped with four long, bony toes. Its arms are more humanoid-looking, covered in a dense layer of dark fur from its shoulders down to its monkey-like paws. Perhaps the oddest aspect of this S'lai's appearance is its vestigal pair of webbed, bat-like wings which protrude from its shoulders.

S'lai screamer.description: Looking like an ill-bred cross between a bat and some sort of lizard-man, the S'lai are a vicious breed of nocturnal cave-dwellers. The Screamer's furry, reptilian head sits atop a dark, scaly torso which in turn is covered with a slight coat of dark hair. Two long, scaly legs, lizard-like in appearance, end in a pair of wide feet, each equipped with four long, bony toes. Its muscular arms are more humanoid-looking, covered in a dense layer of dark fur from its shoulders down to its razor-sharp claws. A pair of half-developed bat wings folded against its back show that at least a few members of this race can fly, though not the creature before you.

Scavenger troll.description: The scavenger troll closely resembles its cousin, the wood troll in appearance and ugliness. Hulking and heavily muscled with rough bark-like skin, it stares down at you with scrutinizing eyes as if wondering whether you have anything worthwhile. Bits of tattered cloth and leather cling to its grotesque form in a haphazard parody of clothing, souvenirs scavenged from the bodies of many a luckless adventurer.

Sabre-toothed warcat.description: A sabre-toothed warcat is covered in pale tawny fur with darker orange flecks. Its shoulders rise almost to your chin, surmounted by a broad flat face and a fluffy tail. Its wide mouth is closed, but long, sabre-like incisors extend about halfway to its chest.

Salt crab.description: The crab has many jointed legs on which it scuttles about at a great rate. A heavily-armored carapace, perhaps the size of a small shield, covers the foul creature and presents a difficult target. It constantly waves two huge claws, each as long as a short sword, armed with serrated edges that could easily tear a hand or foot off of even a large victim. Two tiny eyes on thin, flexible stalks give this unwholesome beast a surprising range of sight and makes it not easily avoided. An aura of fierce rage, causing it to regard anything living as a threat, completes the deadly picture.

Sand sprite.description: The sand sprite is a lithe, agile creature with pinkish skin and long, fine golden hair. Her wild, sea-green eyes flash mischievously as she tries to wreak havok on all that cross her path.

Scout ogre.description: The scout ogre looks like it might be female, but since you're not an ogre it's hard to tell. She's half again as tall as a Gor'Tog and twice as broad, and while she seems to rely more on agility than strength, she's tough and wiry and more than strong enough. Her red eyes flicker with cold agression, and her huge, warty nose is doubtless very attractive to the males of her tribe.

Scaly seordmaor.description: Sleek and black as a nightmare, the scaly seordmaor's resemblance to a panther is uncanny, but it is obviously not wholly natural -- interspersed among its glossy fur are strangely reptilian scales. Occasionally, a sparkle of blue electricity charges down its powerful form, and its flickering eyes betray more than a simple predator's sly cunning.

Rock guardian (1).description: Huge! Approximately twenty feet high, the rock guardian looks like a construct of some kind. The entire thing is made of stone (very much like granite). Even so, the thing does not move awkwardly. Instead, its slow movements seem deliberate, almost graceful. Its face does not appear as fierce as its size might suggest. Instead, it looks almost sad. However, the size of its fists and the shuddering of the ground beneath its massive feet shakes out any cockiness you might have developed. You harbor no illusions. This thing is deadly.

Selkie.description: Not nearly as tall as an ale barrel, the hairless, pink-skinned selkie looks very much like a thin Halfling child wearing a grey pelt cloak. The selkie's golden, almond-shaped eyes glint from beneath the hood like the first light of dawn and it moves with a feline grace that exudes an aura of wisdom as would an ancient creature conscious of its place in time.

Sand spider.description: The sand spider takes after its cousin -- the wolf spider -- in being nearly Human size, with ferocious claws and mandibles. It is a brownish color, to better enable it to blend into the surroundings of its Velaka Desert home.

Rotting deadwood dryad.description: The deadwood dryad is a rather fearsome creature, looking much like a tree that has twisted over many long and painful years into the form of the wretched, yet oddly beautiful, woman before you. Massive, branch-like claws sweep outward from her arms in place of hands, each tapering to a wicked thorn. Evidence of severe blight and rot cover her entire body and her eyes glisten with a disturbing green glow.

Robed Dragon Priest(ess) (1).description: The Dragon priest(ess) is a tall S'Kra Mur (fe)male whose features are hidden by the deep cowl of his/her dark challis robe. (S)He carries in his/her right hand [sic] which glows with a faint purple-tinged eldritch flame. There are a couple tiers of Robed Dragon Priest(esse)s, this one being the lowest.

S'Kra Kor villager (1).description: The S'Kra Kor villager resembles a hideously twisted S'Kra Mur with glistening black scales.

S'Kra Kor warrior (1).description: The S'Kra Kor warrior resembles a hideously twisted and heavily muscled S'Kra Mur with glistening black scales, clawed hands and a wickedly spiked tail.

S'Kra Kor shaman (1).description: A S'Kra Kor shaman is dressed in deeply hooded robes that cloak its face and features in shadow. A long, scaly tail protrudes from beneath its billowing garments, undulating from side to side as it surveys the area with malignant glowing eyes. Clawed, bony hands emerge from ample sleeves, poised to trace patterns of magical destruction.

Ruby-crested adult forest gryphon.description: Smaller than a standard gryphon, the forest gryphon has the body of a bobcat with its fluffy bobbed tail and plush tawny fur, while soft brown and white feathers cover the forequarters and wings. The creature's cat-slitted orange eyes are flecked with crimson veins around the pupil. A mane of ruby crest feathers frames the beast's falcon-like head, ruffled by each passing breeze.

Scavenger goblin.description: Standing on two legs, the scavenger goblin is somewhat small, like a Dwarf. It looks passive but wary.

Ruffian (creature1).description: Like so many people who moved to The Crossing in the hopes of acquiring a new dream and a new life, the ruffian is one of many who failed, having little choice but to take up the life of common scum just to get by in the world. From the way he eyes your money pouch, however, you're not sure exactly how much pity you can dish out to this person. After all, the ruffian did make the decision to live his life this way...right?

Its skin is a grey slate color, and the nails on its hideous hands are broken and yellowed. Beneath them, you notice bits of flesh and dirt, and the stench of rotting flesh and decay is thick about the brutal creature.

River sprite.description: A river sprite is a lithe, agile creature with pale green skin and flowing green hair. Her blue-green eyes flash with mischief as she dances about in a ceaseless blur of motion. Her alluring body is clothed in a seaweed skirt.

Rough-hewn doll.description: Although it was likely once a child's well-loved toy, the knee-high little doll is covered with ugly rust-colored streaks all over its face and hands, which drip down onto its once-fine clothing. A simple little smile graces its face, doing little to counter the madness in its eyes. Seeming hungry, it stalks about, apparently looking for prey.

Two stubby legs, lizard-like in appearance, end in a pair of wide feet, each equipped with four long, bony toes. Its arms are more humanoid-looking, covered in a dense layer of dark fur from its shoulders down to its slender hands. Perhaps the oddest aspect of this S'lai's appearance is its vestigal pair of webbed, bat-like wings which protrude from its shoulders.

Sailfin lizard.description: Massing as much as a large Gnome, a sailfin lizard has four legs that splay out from its body, each limb ending in a webbed set of toes ending in wickedly sharp claws. Set on its back is the sail that gives the lizard its name, which the beast can either hold erect or flatten down close to the spine. Each lizard's hide is colored in one of a range of jewel-like colors, making their skins prized by tanners.

Saendalen shark.description: They come in many sizes and varieties, but for most people who encounter these sleek predators, it is the rows of razor-sharp teeth and soulless black eyes that will forever linger in their minds.

Savannah bull.description: Standing about eight feet at the shoulder, the savannah bull is an awe-inspiring sight, with a mottled grey and white hide, cloud-shrouded horns, and a mist-tipped tail.

A long, scaly tail protrudes from beneath its billowing garments, undulating from side to side as it surveys the area with malignant glowing eyes. S'Kra Kor dancer.description: ===Alive=== The S'Kra Kor dancer resembles a large, twisted S'Kra Mur with black scales and a barbed tail. However, it has a rather lithe body and moves about in a constant dance.

S'Kra Kor villager (2).description: ===Alive=== The S'Kra Kor villager resembles a hideously twisted S'Kra Mur with glistening black scales.

Scarecrow (Creature).description: Alive: Dressed in tattered black rags that drape over him like a voluminous cloak and with twisted gnarled roots making up his limbs, the Scarecrow stands with arms outstretched. In place of a face is a tattered burlap bag, with an unnatural orange fire lighting up his hollow eyes. His face is covered with a painted on grin, and the large straw hat on his head only serves to make him appear more sinister. Dead: The Scarecrow is little more than a lumpy black cloak covered in bits of straw.

Sandstone golem.description: Made up almost entirely of chunks of sandstone that form rudimentary arms, legs, torso and head, the sandstone golem appears to be held together with some strange sort of magic. Glowing crystal eyes highlight its otherwise featureless head.

Rockclaw lobster covered with algae tuft.description: The Human-sized rockclaw lobster crouches low, perched on segmented legs. Whip-like antennae and twitching eyes hidden in a barnacle-encrusted rostrum betray predatory instincts. Deep blue and red mottled patterning decorates the brown, heavily scarred carapace, and two enormous claws are held forward threateningly.

Robed banyakea.description: Though it appears to have once been a normal four-legged creature, the mutilated banyakea now has numerous extra arms and legs that appear grafted onto its torso, which is twisted from the weight of all the extra limbs. Though most of them look useless and simply hang off its body, several of the limbs move and writhe as if alive. The mutilated banyakea also appears to be in a great deal of pain, its movements jerky and twisting constantly.

Salt golem.description: Standing over twenty feet tall, a salt golem is a being made entirely out of salt, except for its eyes which glow an eerie dark red color and appear to be the source of its animation. Specks of salt constantly shed from its massive frame, showering to the ground in waves. It stares forward with an uncaring gaze, although there is a deep-rooted malevolence in its ethereal eyes.

Seething summit sunderer.description: Sharing the same rugged features and richly dyed robes of the other Leoran settlers, the summit sunderer moves strangely, his body constantly twitching with discordant movements. Intermittently, he sheds arcs of lightning that flow along his body before fading away.

Small grendel.description: About five feet in height and a light pink color, a small grendel is a humanoid creature with short, upright ears, small eyes that resemble black beads, and an upturned snout for a nose. Perpetually hungry, the small grendel searches endlessly for food, sometimes dining on tubers, but often craving soft meat.

Silverfish.description: Silverfish are table-sized creatures encased in a hard, silvery exoskeleton. Three tail-like appendages at the end of their abdomen look strong enough to shatter bone and their front legs sport a razor sharp edge. Mandible clattering incessantly, these are hive creatures and their primal instinct is to bring food to the nest. Any food.

Skunk.description: A long white stripe of fur parts the skunk's black mass of hair from head to tail. Its beautiful coat and diminutive size makes the animal appear harmless, but one whiff of its foul smelling spray should easily change such thoughts.

Skeletal kobold headhunter.description: The fleshless skeleton before you is clearly of the kobold race, looking like a strange cross between human and common alley mutt. Its bones have been picked completely clean of carrion, revealing a strangely elongated and contorted structure beneath. Its bulky form appears strong for a kobold, and capable of steady, devastating blows.

Skeletal kobold savage.description: The fleshless skeleton before you is clearly of the kobold race, looking like a strange cross between human and common alley mutt. Its bones have been picked completely clean of carrion, revealing a strangely elongated and contorted structure beneath. Its bulky form appears strong for a kobold, and capable of steady, devastating blows.

Sleek hele'la.description: The sleek hele'la is quick, smooth and a very large water lizard with a muscular tail. Its jaw is slightly agape due to the presence of several rows of overly long and needlesharp teeth. It looks like it's smiling.

Small boggle.description: Thin and dark black in color, the small boggle is a member of the Fae, its body composed seemingly of sticks and stones, its head round and bulbous and quite out of proportion with the rest of it. Perhaps the imagery that comes to mind when you gaze upon the foul mischief-maker is that of a rotten gourd ready to burst stuck onto the top of a beanpole with stick-like arms and legs and joints of pebbles. Known for its malicious tendencies -- including leading children or sheep into wells or spoiling milk before it has left the cow's udders -- the boggle is notorious for practical jokes that leave the victim confused, frustrated, and frequently dead.

Sinuous elsralael.description: A sinuous elsralael is a leathery creature with a barbed tail and many rows of sharp teeth lining its mouth. Local legend holds that the creature is beloved of Drogor, the god of angry seas. From its grey-green scales to its leathery white underbelly, the creature seems right at home in Drogor's realms.

Shadoweaver.description: The dense shadows of the demon forest coalesce into the stunningly perfect form of a <your race> battle maiden whose pearl-white eyes gaze back at you seductively. The shadoweaver moves lithely through the air, weaving a dark tapestry of alluring malevolence that threatens to wrap you in its chilling folds.

Sleazy lout.description: The sleazy lout is a young adult, and as he moves through the area he looks around with fiery rebellion in his eyes. With grungy clothes and an equally dirty body, the lout looks ready to fight anything seen as an easy mark.

Silver leucro.description: Sleek and lean, the silver leucro shares the wolfish qualities of its larger relative, the giant black leucro. It has fur that ranges from brown to dark grey, but always tipped in bright silver. Often traveling in packs, the silver leucro can overwhelm the unprepared solitary traveler.

Shadefield eviscerator.description: Though obviously agile, the shadefield eviscerator is awkwardly hunched over in an exaggerated mockery of a humanoid's stance. Several deadly bone blades, each at least three times as long as its torso, dangle from its lithe form, set at the end of wispy arms. Jutting from this menagerie of shadows and jagged weaponry, a skeletal bovine head maintains a disturbing fleshless smile as it surveys the area.

Shaderald.description: The shaderald drifts in and out of your field of vision like smoke, as if it were not wholly substantial. Though difficult to focus on, what you can see of the shaderald is bulky and four-legged, with a massive hooked beak that it angles awkwardly forward. Shadowy feathers flicker from its form now and again, dissipating as they fall away while others ruffle up to take their place.

Silver-tipped mature forest gryphon.description: Smaller than a standard gryphon, the forest gryphon has the body of a bobcat with its fluffy bobbed tail and plush tawny fur, while soft brown and white feathers cover the forequarters and wings. The creature's cat-slitted orange eyes are flecked with crimson veins around the pupil. The dark brown wing feathers have a silvery sheen to their quills for a graceful sparkling effect.

Shaggy black barghest.description: A shaggy black barghest resembles a shaggy-coated black dog, but its true nature is revealed by its silver-flecked emerald green eyes and the smoking footprints it leaves behind. Of medium size, its head comes to about the height of your knees.

Small peccary (1).description: At first glance, you think "boar" but when you see the peccary in full, and notice the three-toed hind feet, you realize this is a different animal entirely. However, like the common boar, the tiny eyes and massive snout are caged behind two mean-looking curved tusks. Its startlingly white lips contrast sharply with its dark grey, almost black hide.

Seordhevor kartais.description: With a body curved like a puffy white prawn, the seordhevor kartais holds itself aloft with a pair of leathery, batlike wings. These are its only non-insectoid features, however -- from its sides dangle two sets of wispy, segmented legs which straddle the arm-length, waspish stinger arching beneath its main body.

Skeletal sailor.description: The skeletal sailor's seaweed-draped frame glows with an unholy light giving it an appearance of extraordinary power. Moving with a grace and speed that belies its current physical state, its empty eyes shine with a brilliant green luminescence. The briny vestments writhe occasionally, reaching out to search the surrounding area of their own accord.

Snaer hafwa.description: The snaer hafwa is a vaporous white mist that glistens like lacy ice crystals. Tendril-like hands with knife-like claws flail the air, and dark cold eyes glare from within the vapor. It moves with purpose and drifts about lightly and delicately.

Sinister Maelshyvean hierophant.description: The hierophant is nothing more than the befouled remains of a fallen priest, corrupted and turned to do the bidding of a false deity. The creature is entirely shrouded in tattered black robes, concealing all about it but its vague shape.

Sky giant.description: Standing 18 feet tall and weighing several tons, a sky giant looks like nothing so much as a huge Human warrior, with slightly pointed ears and a wild thatch of red-brown hair. The illusion is shattered by his face, which is marked by glaring fiery eyes an evilly grinning fanged mouth.

Slender ribbon adder.description: No more than eighteen inches long, this ribbon adder has a nasty disposition entirely out of proportion with its size. In fact it looks more like a green bootlace than anything else. The adder more than makes up in speed and agility what it lacks in strength, however, and a score of bites from a score of ribon adders would not be a pleasant experience.

Shadowy black death spirit.description: The black death spirit is a mass of swirling shadow given substance. Clothed in little but the rag of a robe, its hands are terribly jagged claws, its eyes a glowing sanguine color. The creature appears to have the mentality of the damned, moving with intention and deadly grace as it floats about.

Sickly blightwater nyad.description: Resembling a bizarre sculpture of murky grey water more than anything living, the nyad may have been breathtakingly beautiful once, but all that remains now is this wretched creature. Bits of rotting vegetation cling to the terribly attenuated limbs of the blightwater nyad and her sickly yellow eyes blaze with hatred, reflecting the madness consuming her very being.

Sinuous ice adder.description: Thick with frost and ice crystals, glacial winds swirl tightly around the skeletal frame of the ice adder. Its eye sockets blaze with an unearthly blue radiance, casting a pallid light that gleams off its glistening fangs. Wisps of bluish-white mist trail behind it as it moves, drifting delicately from its body. Dead: The spectral winds animating the adder have dissipated, leaving behind bones and melting ice.

Shambling horror.description: Gaunt skin covers the shambling horror, tightly stretched over bone and rotting sinew. It is obviously humanoid, but so badly distended and bloated are its features that precisely what race is a mystery. A stench of decay rises from the horror, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice.

Shifty-eyed skinflint.description: This beast of a man has clearly tasted the pleasures of the good life, as evidenced by his fine attire and bloated stomach. Perhaps a former trader or wandering merchant, his overwhelming greed has completely consumed him, only to leave him in a state of insatiable lust for material wealth. His eyes grow as large as the coins in his pouch as he appraises you from head to toe. You can almost hear him counting the cash as he sells off your possessions to the imaginary pawn shop in his deluded mind.

Skeletal mass.description: Made from a foul-smelling substance black as pitch, the mass is animated by an unknown, magical force. Huge yellow eyes stare down from its oversized sockets, appearing like smooth and uniform spheres rather than anything that could be called natural. Constantly searching for new prey, the mass hunts down the living, and though a strong magic masks its nature its shape and movements hint at the dreaded curse of undeath.

Silver-backed bear.description: Huge, dagger like claws and an angry muzzle covered in the caked blood are frightening, but do little to detract from the silver-backed bear's radiant coat.

Skorik nadhar.description: The skorik nadhar resembles a slender snake shrouded in several layers of frost-covered scales that gleam like a collage of precious gems. Elegant designs ripple across its surface as it shifts under the pale silver starlight. Twin pairs of ethereal wings protude from the nadhar's back, each wing assaulting the air beneath it with incredible ferocity to keep the beast aloft. Its deep-set eyes glint like two icy sapphires, occasionally flashing with a dangerous inner light which hints at the beast's cunning.

Shadowy umbral colossus.description: Formed of shadows of the deepest black, the colossus is a roughly shaped humanoid that towers over fifty feet tall. Two bony vestigial wings sprout from its back and its thick, tendril-like fingers reach nearly to the ground. It moves with ponderous care, sending quakes through the ground with every plodding step.

Small crevice worm.description: The crevice worm looks like a big tube made of rock, dust, and precious metal. Oozing between the cracks in its hard rock shell is the acid that holds the rocks on and helps it move freely through the underground passageways. Having no real head, it leads and bashes prey with one end of its symmetrical body and uses the other as a feeler to sense its next meal through vibrations in the rock.

Shinkin.description: If ever there could be a race of sewer-dwelling goblins, surely the Shinkin would fit the bill. About three feet tall and slight of build, the Shinkin are most noted for their yellow teeth, foul disposition and above all their horrendous stench. Some believe them to be made of the very slime into which they explode when killed, but it would be a rare soul indeed brave enough to test the theory.

Small pixie.description: The small pixie is a lithe, agile creature with long streaming hair tucked under a pointed hat. Sharp, pointed teeth gleam in her perpetually grinning mouth.

Small zombie piranha.description: While retaining the jaws and sleek body it had in life, this fish is no longer living. Its body is pale and decaying, but it has lost little of its taste for flesh.

Small birdcatcher spider.description: Introduced in Tuesday Tidings 66. Premium Only.

Snippet.description: Were it not for its quick, serpentine movements, the silk snippet could easily be mistaken for a stray scrap of fabric caught on the breeze. Instead, it strongly resembles a flying eel, swimming swiftly through the air with a ribbony body that terminates in a shredded row of improvised teeth.

Small peccary (2).description: At first glance, you think "boar" but when you see the peccary in full, and notice the three-toed hind feet, you realize this is a different animal entirely. However, like the common boar, the tiny eyes and massive snout are caged behind two mean-looking curved tusks. Its startlingly white lips contrast sharply with its dark grey, almost black hide.

Shadewing harpy.description: The harpy has a hawkish, Human-like face with sharply angular features and piercing yellow eyes. Her iridescent jet-black feathers are tipped in cobalt, resembling blue fire against a night sky. The harpy's feathered body is clad in a makeshift tunic, patched together from scavenged cloth and leaves.

Small tree sloth.description: With long arms tipped with scythe-like claws, the tree sloth is a formidable foe despite a reputation for placidity.

Snarlvine fox.description: Snarlvine foxes possess distinctly vulpine features, but with the size of a large wolf. A dense coat of deep green-black fur covers its lean frame, each hair tipped in silvery white that creates a layered pattern across the body. Bright lilac eyes stand out sharply against the darker coloration, with night-dark markings down its legs and across its muzzle. Delicate vines form a sprawling lattice from nose to tail, winding across the creature's lanky body like ivy climbing a stone wall. Small pastel blossoms emerge at irregular intervals from the living network of green tendrils, while slender creepers thread between the flowers and fur. A long brush-like tail trails behind it, interwoven with thorned growth and flowering tendrils.

Snowbeast.description: With a pure white coat and gleaming green eyes, the snowbeast appears to be a cruel hybrid of a snow leopard and a timber wolf, except pushed into a hideously twisted and expanded form. Patches of its fur have been rubbed off from its own frantic scratching, revealing a scaley surface underneath. Drooling with a frantic and permanent need for food, nothing sates it so easily as warm, tender red meat.

Swamp troll (1).description: The swamp troll is a tall, ungainly humanoid-shaped conglomeration of branches, leaves, mud, and foulness... or at least that's all that's visible. Rumor has it there is flesh and bone beneath the plant matter, but if so, it's probably even uglier than the crud that covers it.

Spiny dyrachis.description: The dyrachis is a six-legged burrowing beast about the size of a yak. When it feels threatened, it can inflate air sacs beneath its skin to display its long sharp quills glistening with poison -- and then use that air to fire the quills with great force.

Tenebraeling (creature).description: The tenebraeling is a little bundle of bristling black fur, grasping claws, and a flurry of rapidly beating wings. Its ugly, batlike face with its beady eyes is barely visible amidst the rest of its chaotic form.

Striped badger.description: The badger is a sturdy, wily-looking animal, with a low, sleek body, a flat head with a slender snout full of teeth, and a set of formidable claws. Its shiny fur is striped in brown and black and white. It waddles when it walks, but can move quickly when it needs to.

Sun vulture.description: Propped up on two huge talons, this vulture stands as a giant over its airborne cousins. The skin of this bear-sized beast is painted in charred blackness, covered by short, stiff hairs. Though equipped with fully functioning wings, the thing appears to be flightless despite an overly abundant amount of flapping.

Snow goblin (1).description: The snow race is::goblin, standing about as tall as a short Human but with a much broader torso, is clearly a distant cousin of the smaller, common goblin. Its full, white hair and thick skin give evidence that the breed has adapted well to its frigid surroundings.

Spectral pirate.description: A dessicated parrot is perched on the pirate's shoulder.

Supple firecat.description: The supple firecat is a large cat of sleek build with powerful leaping muscles that ripple beneath its thick black coat. Flames flicker above its tufted ears, and its eyes shift from red to gold to blue as it watches, waiting for the perfect opportunity to pounce.

Telga moradu.description: Living amongst the aftermath of explosions and sulfurous gasses, the telga moradu towers over the nearby trees. Tiny fissures spider across its dark, hardened skin. His stained face is nearly obscured by a bushy beard full of branches and leaves.

Storm bull (1).description: Standing about eight feet at the shoulder, the storm bull is an awe-inspiring sight, with a glistening silvery hide, long pearly horns, and a mist-tipped tail.

Stone-throwing imp.description: The stone-throwing imp is completely hairless, myriad blue veins clearly visible beneath its pale pink, translucent skin. A pair of saucer-like, ice-blue eyes stare out of a pinched face and gleam with mischievousness, looking for trouble. Its hands are long-fingered with flattened fingertips. The stone-throwing imp has long, gangly limbs and wears a ragged assortment of clothing presumably scavenged from its victims.

Spriggan (creature).description: Cruel cunning etches the face of this small, twisted creature. Standing about the height of a Halfling, the spriggan resembles a grotesque mockery of humanity with black, unblinking eyes, gnarled limbs, and bark-like skin.

Spiny bloodfish (2).description: They come in many sizes and varieties, but for most people who encounter these sleek predators, it is the rows of razor-sharp teeth and souless black eyes that will forever linger in their minds.

Stumpy blight ogre.description: Although smaller than his warmer-climate cousins, the blight ogre displays a cunning, leading one to believe he might be more dangerous. Beady red eyes squint from beneath shaggy grey brows as he snuffles the air. Yellowing tusks, a warty nose and thick, mottled hide the color of old bruises combine into features only a mother could love ... and even that is doubtful.

Stark white skeletal archer.description: Standing on two legs, the skeletal archer is humanoid size. It is obviously aggressive and looking for a fight.

Tanri immola.description: The immola resembles a troll in build, but the similarities end there. Large, curling black horns protrude from its broad forehead, and dark ridges shade beady black eyes. The most outstanding feature is his boil-covered skin. Streaks of fiery-colored veins sit close to the surface, rupturing occasionally and leaking the immola's overheated blood. Between this and his penchant for violence, the immola is not a pretty sight.

Suw bizar.description: Looking like some sort of deformed octopus, the suw bizar is little more than a collection of water contained within a thin membranous lining. Several tentacles branch out from its bulbous head, each laden with smaller sprouts that may one day become tentacles themselves. Though clearly a creature of wet environs, its muscular tentacles look adept for pulling it over dry land when necessary.

Spiny bloodfish (1).description: They come in many sizes and varieties, but for most people who encounter these sleek predators, it is the rows of razor-sharp teeth and souless black eyes that will forever linger in their minds.

Spider crab.description: Seemingly all legs and claws, the spider crab stands tall on its spindly limbs high above the ground. White spots decorate the dark orange carapace, which is oval shaped and covered in fine hairs. Spider crabs are found on the sandy eastern shores of the Seord Fal River and come in two sizes: Huge and Gigantic. They are resistant to puncture and slice damage.

Spotted kashika serpent.description: Intricate patterns of greens, browns and black cover the dull scales of the kashika serpent, making it difficult to distinguish from its surroundings.

Spotted shark.description: They come in many sizes and varieties, but for most people who encounter these sleek predators, it is the rows of razor-sharp teeth and souless black eyes that will forever linger in their minds.

Spotted bobcat.description: The spotted bobcat is poised, graceful, and appears to be at ease yet ready to spring. It fixes its golden eyes on you, and you are mesmerized for a moment, yet your instincts scream to submit as you look away first. Finally the spotted bobcat turns his attention elsewhere, looking bored by the encounter. Yet you are certain it will mark your every move with a wariness it does not show.

Stalwart Asketian herald.description: Covered head to toe in thick steel, there's not much to see other than the almost glowing red eyes glaring back at you. The same red eyes, seemingly detached from whatever form the creature has, peek watchfully from within, actively scanning the area. Blood-red adders depicted on the equipment suggest it is constantly looking for something to hunt to ruin in the name of Asketi.

Spotted Fungus Colepexy.description: One could almost describe the fungus colepexy as a living set of wings, such is the size of the dragonfly-like pairs this one exhibits. The tiny body he has is reminscent of a ladybird, complete with black spots dappled along his red shell. Rather than a bug's head, however, he has a bizarre, Human-like face that smiles pleasantly at anyone he notices.

Spriggan.description: Cruel cunning etches the face of this small, twisted creature. Standing about the height of a Halfling, the spriggan resembles a grotesque mockery of humanity with black, unblinking eyes, gnarled limbs, and bark-like skin.

Tattooed akul'tiz.description: The Akul'tiz is a short, plump humanoid swathed in a blue robe, with hairless grey skin that hangs flaccidly from its frame. It goes barefoot, which may help account for the creature's remarkable speed and agility. Tipping its grub-like fingers are long, sharpened nails painted a bright malachite-green. Its rattish face wears a fixed smile on jaws too wide, teeth too white. Zebra-tattooed: This particular Akul'tiz has crude zebra markings tattooed across its arms. Maculated: This particular Akul'tiz has uneven dapples tattooed upon its throat. Shrike-tattooed: This particular Akul'tiz has a flock of detailed shrike tattoos perching and soaring throughout its whole body but the face. Moth-tattooed: This particular Akul'tiz has a rabble of umbral moth tattoos alighted delicately all over its torso and shoulders.

Telga orek (1).description: Oozing about as a gelatinous slime that could fill a small pool, a telga orek writhes and seethes with necromantic corruption. Its body quivers a bit as it moves about in search of prey, and hundreds of eyes blink out from numerous tendrils that grow and shrink randomly from its jelly-like body.

Rumor has it there is flesh and bone beneath the plant matter, but if so, it's probably even uglier than the crud that covers it.

Starcrasher.description: The starcrasher resembles an unfortunate cross between a ten-legged arachnid and a colorful starfish, though it moves like neither. Its integument looks fibrous and prismatic, coaxing your eyes to slide off every time they try to get a fix.

Starlight harbinger.description: The starlight harbinger has the same bauplan as its inferior cousin: a pseudo-spider with too many legs. Whereas a starcrasher's integument is translucent, this creature shines a blinding white -- itself a living array of ripped seams between Elanthian air and some cold star.

Storm bull (2).description: Standing about eight feet at the shoulder, the storm bull is an awe-inspiring sight, with a glistening silvery hide, long pearly horns, and a mist-tipped tail.

Sylph (1).description: The sylph is a whirling mass of shredded silk and other textiles, held perpetually aloft on unseen air currents. Although at times it appears as nothing more than a tangle of airborne cloth, it generally maintains a lithe humanoid form, complete with malevolently glowing eyes and razor-sharp tatters for claws. It swirls about the area with rambunctious abandon, apparently looking for trouble to cause.

Stunted undead gerbil.description: Although superficially it resembles a mage's familiar, closer examination reveals a crackling aura surrounding it. Grey fur covers its body and bloodshot eyes stare back at you with malevolence. Sharp ivory-colored teeth jut from its mouth and keen-edged claws cap the tiny limbs.

Sovamedo cub.description: Though a child of its species, the sovamedo cub is still a sizeable creature possessed of brutish strength and agility and a keen instinct to kill and devour its prey. The owl- and bear-like features so obvious in the elder sovamedo are less defined in the cub, but a fine layer of lightly colored fur covers its lower body while short, dark feathers wreath its neck. Fledgling claws peek out from the tip of each paw. The sovamedo cub primarily moves about on all fours, as its balance when standing on its hind legs hasn't fully developed.

Thunder ram.description: Though nearly five feet tall, and equipped with a deadly set of curved horns, the ram seems more interested in chomping on grass than running down visitors to its home.

Vile plague wraith.description: Held aloft by two expansive skeletal wings, the massive plague wraith towers over thirty feet tall. Under its tattered cloak, a black mass of writhing insects and serpents cling tightly to a nearly fleshless skeleton. Four elongated arms, covered in a tangle of scorpions and spiders, end in wickedly curved talons that twitch in anticipation of its next victim. Practically obscured by the inky shadows cast by its voluminous hood, two flaming emerald eyes partially illuminate its malevolent hook-toothed skull.

Tortured soul (1).description: Expanding and contracting, the tortured soul is hard to make out. Basically humanoid in form in shape its body twists and shudders as if in excruciating pain. At times it takes on some solidity and the vague form of a person in torment can be seen. While its body may be nothing but a twisted mass of essence, its teeth and claws look real enough, willing and able to rend your soul from your body!

Ur hhrki'izh (1).description: The Ur Hhrki'izh is an ancient S'Kra Mur, long past its natural lifetime. Its flesh, eyes, and internal organs are long gone, leaving only scaly skin stretched over a skeletal frame and two sullen fires burning in its otherwise empty eye sockets. But even its frightening appearance is not as disturbing as its fluid, languid motion combined with the dry rattling and clicking of old bones.

Trollkin.description: The trollkin is a smaller, distorted version of its larger cousins, and because of this it has a bad attitude. Its gangly arms and legs are wrapped in ropy muscle, and its brownish-green skin is covered with sores and bumps and expulsions of various sorts, each more disgusting than the last.

Vicious warcat.description: A vicious warcat is covered in pale tawny fur, flecked with light brown. Its shoulders rise almost to your chin, surmounted by a broad flat face and a fluffy tail. Pale yellow eyes gleam above its wide mouth, open to reveal fist-sized fangs.

Transparent shylvic.description: Two blazing green eyes peer out from a transparent faced framed by a hood that is barely there. Diaphanous frost-tinged robes of rippling ether cloak the shylvic's Human-esque stature. You find it difficult to focus upon its form, as the outline of the surroundings bleed through, obscuring its translucent body. A faint, icy aura of frost permeates the air around the apparition as it floats aloft, a few feet off the ground.

Vela'tohr bloodvine.description: The sinuous vine's slender body undulates beneath a mantle of red-tinged leaves covering it like plate armor. The glistening, toxic liquid coating the serrated blood-red thorns indicates this is surely some species of flesh-eating plant. Though eyeless, you have the uncanny impression that it looks upon you with ill intent.

Vaporous blood wraith.description: A hideous amalgam of disembodied Human organs floats in the air before you - two eyes dangling with bloodied optic cords, a beating heart, and a ragged coil of throbbing entrails. The various parts drift aimlessly in their relative positions in the body, held aloft by a thick crimson mist that forms the faint outline of a malformed Human man. The shroud of fog suffuses the area wherever the being travels, bringing the heavy, copper-tinged taste of blood to your mouth.

Velakan slaver.description: Equipped with a sturdy-looking net of woven hemp, the Velakan slaver looks around with a calculating eye.

Vengeful shade.description: The shade has a flowing, rippling, translucent form and a face twisted by pain and hatred. Its legs fade into a cloud of dust stirred up by its shadowy wings. As it clenches and unclenches its fists repeatedly, its sharp claws cut deeply into its palms, drawing phantasmal blood.

Velver.description: The velver is incredibly small, if it were not for its deep ebon color and the fact it is usually carrying an itsy bitsy bow you might mistake it for a rodent. The velver wears a constant grin.

Thug (creature4).description: Like so many people who moved to The Crossing in the hopes of acquiring a new dream and a new life, the thug is one of many who failed, having little choice but to take up the life of common scum just to get by in the world. From the way he eyes your money pouch, however, you're not sure exactly how much pity you can dish out to this person. After all, the thug did make the decision to live his life this way...right?

At times it takes on some solidity and the vague form of a person in torment can be seen. While its body may be nothing but a twisted mass of essence, its teeth and claws look real enough, willing and able to rend your soul from your body!

Despite the fact that its features are badly distended and bloated, the lupine nature of its former race in moonskin is evident. A stench of decay rises from the zombie, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice.

Unctuous Prydaen zombie.description: Mangy skin covers the race is::Prydaen zombie, tightly stretched over bone and rotting sinew. Despite the fact that its features are badly distended and bloated, the feline nature of its former race is evident. A stench of decay rises from the zombie, and flies swarm about every oozing orifice.

Tiger shark.description: They come in many sizes and varieties, but for most people who encounter these sleek predators, it is the rows of razor-sharp teeth and souless black eyes that will forever linger in their minds.

Twisted skeletal hound.description: Picked clean of all fleshy tissue by buzzards, maggots, or a combination of both, the skeletal hulk of a mastiff rises tall before you. Its feral canine body is unnaturally elongated and twisted into exaggerated knots, likely by the same force that animates it beyond Eylhaar's embrace. A sickly green light glistens within its empty eyesockets, a sign of its foul pact with some Necromantic entity.

Troublesome tightwad.description: This beast of a man has clearly tasted the pleasures of the good life, as evidenced by his fine attire and bloated stomach. Perhaps a former trader or wandering merchant, his overwhelming greed has completely consumed him, only to leave him in a state of insatiable lust for material wealth. His eyes grow as large as the coins in his pouch as he appraises you from head to toe. You can almost hear him counting the cash as he sells off your possessions to the imaginary pawn shop in his deluded mind.

Treehopper toad.description: The treehopper toad is quite large, taller than an adult Halfling and nearly twice as broad. Its long fingers are webbed for easy climbing up and down even the most slippery of slopes, and its powerful, legs can jump great distances in short order. The toad's skin is brightly colored and glossy, glistening with deadly excretions designed to quickly disorient and neutralize its prey.

Umbral moth.description: The atramentous moth is a dark thing cloaked in flickering, baleful shadow, vaguely insectile in form. Its flesh seems nearly as mercurial as smoke, constantly evolving through irregular, chaotic shapes. The creature's bulbous compound eyes are utterly matte and unreflective, each crowned by an antenna which bears an uncanny resemblance to the soft, questing arm of an infant Human, complete with tiny growths resembling inquisitive, chubby fingers. A slick proboscis protrudes from the moth's mouth, dangling obscenely against its thorax. Most striking are the creature's massive wings, spreading fractally above and around its body like drops of dark ink shifting through water.

Thunder eel.description: == Varieties == * Onyx * Smalt * Lapis-hued * Turquoise * Cerulean * Teal * Milky * Alabaster

Twisted dryad.description: The twisted dryad's skin is dark brownish-black, and patterned like bark. A mane of hair composed of blighted and decaying leaves cascades down her back and shoulders and her glowing saffron eyes glare hatefully at you, as if accusing you of wrongs done to her kind in the past. Her hands end in massive claws that resemble branches, and a sticky, reddish substance covers her skin, glistening slightly.

Veteran orc skirmisher.description: Small, thankfully unidentifiable black creatures crawl around in the veteran skirmisher's greasy grey hair. With fastidious personal habits of a peccary in a mud-pit, the skirmisher stops from time to time to pick one of the insects off her scalp and pop it into her mouth, smacking her lips greedily as he chews. Standing no more than a hand's width higher than the average human, the skirmisher's musculature is considerably more dense, with thick bones and an almost ape-like curve to its skull. A red bear paw has been tattooed on her shoulder, identifying her as a member of the member of::red bear clan of race is::orcs.

Tree snake.description: Quick and lithe, the green tree snake is a blur of movement, with only the occasional glimpse of fangs to show why it is a feared opponent in the forest. Ambushes from hiding Spawns with birdcatcher spiders which are poisonous

Thug (creature5).description: Like so many people who moved to The Crossing in the hopes of acquiring a new dream and a new life, the thug is one of many who failed, having little choice but to take up the life of common scum just to get by in the world. From the way he eyes your money pouch, however, you're not sure exactly how much pity you can dish out to this person. After all, the thug did make the decision to live his life this way...right?

Ur-maeldryth.description: Inexplicably connected to its surroundings, the gigantic ur-maeldryth appears utterly at home. Dozens of fleshy, clawed tentacles plated with large midnight-blue scales snake outward from a nexus of chalky black bone. With a tremendously long reach, they thrash about feverishly, the triple-tined claws snapping in every direction.

Undead gerbil.description: Although superficially it resembles a mage's familiar, closer examination reveals a crackling aura surrounding it. Grey fur covers its body and bloodshot eyes stare back at you with malevolence. Sharp ivory-colored teeth jut from its mouth and keen-edged claws cap the tiny limbs. (Premium Only)

Twisted fendryad (1).description: The fendryad is an emaciated faerie woman with dark, wrinkled skin, faintly glowing green eyes and skeletal leaves tangled in her sodden hair. According to legend, these creatures of the swamps and fens were once dryads, tied to the trees, until the coming of Man "tamed" the forests and drove the gentle creatures to death... or to madness. Evidently the fendryad belong to the latter class, for the glowing green eyes betray hatred and cunning without a trace of sanity.
